title: PERFORMANCE GRAPHIC DESIGNER — STATIC AD
description:
We are looking for a Performance Graphic Designer to create high-converting static ads for a fast-growing DTC beauty brand.



This role is focused on direct-response advertising — not general branding or organic social media design.



You should be able to understand a creative brief, identify the correct information hierarchy and visual format, and independently turn the strategy into a strong static ad designed for paid social.



Compensation includes a competitive monthly base salary plus performance-based bonuses for creatives that achieve meaningful results.





KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



• Create performance-focused static ads for Meta and other paid social channels based on creative briefs.

• Translate hooks, copy, offers, proof points, and product benefits into clear, compelling visual hierarchy.

• Select and adapt suitable layouts, swipe references, and proven ad formats for different creative concepts.

• Produce meaningful iterations of winning ads by testing headlines, visuals, layouts, proof elements, CTAs, and other variables.

• Use AI tools to create or edit models, facial expressions, skin details, gestures, product scenes, backgrounds, and other required assets.

• Work closely with Creative Strategists, respond quickly to feedback, and deliver organized editable files in the required formats.



REQUIREMENTS



• Proven experience creating direct-response static ads for DTC or e-commerce brands.

• Strong understanding of typography, information hierarchy, readability, composition, and conversion-focused design.

• Able to understand and execute creative briefs independently — not just copy references mechanically.

• Experienced in producing multiple meaningful variations from one winning concept.

• Proficient in Figma and/or Photoshop, with strong practical experience using AI image-generation and editing tools.

• Strong attention to product accuracy, human anatomy, faces, hands, skin texture, lighting, and overall visual realism.

• Fast, reliable, detail-oriented, and comfortable with frequent creative testing and revisions.

• Beauty, skincare, cosmetics, wellness, or personal care experience is a strong plus.

• Ability to suggest controlled copy or wording variations is also a plus. 



HOW TO APPLY



PLEASE FOLLOW ALL INSTRUCTIONS BELOW. APPLICATIONS THAT DO NOT FOLLOW THESE REQUIREMENTS MAY NOT BE CONSIDERED.



Please include the following:



1. Your portfolio link, preferably including direct-response static ads for paid social.

2. If you have worked with any beauty, skincare, cosmetics, wellness, or personal care brands, please specify the brand names and include links to relevant work.

3. Your CV or LinkedIn profile.

4. What is your current work situation? Are you employed full-time, working part-time, freelancing, or currently available?

5. When would you be available to start if selected?

6. What is your expected monthly salary in USD?

7. What design tools do you regularly use? Please specify your experience with Figma and/or Photoshop.

8. What AI image-generation or editing tools do you use? Briefly explain how you use them in your workflow.

9. From a clear creative brief with the necessary assets provided, how many NET-NEW STATIC AD CONCEPTS can you normally complete in one working day?

10. From an existing concept or winning ad, how many MEANINGFUL VARIATIONS can you normally complete in one working day?



Please do not count simple resizes or format adaptations as new creatives.



11. How long do you normally need to revise one static ad after receiving clear feedback?

12. Briefly explain how you would take one winning static ad and turn it into multiple genuinely different variations for further testing.



IMPORTANT



This role is specifically focused on performance advertising.



We are looking for designers who understand that a strong paid-social creative is not just visually attractive — it must communicate the right message quickly, establish a clear hierarchy, and support the intended conversion goal.



Applications without a relevant static-ad portfolio may not be considered.

title: Operations Assistant / Operations Coordinator
description:
We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Operations Assistant / Operations Coordinator to support day-to-day operations, coordinate projects, and ensure that deadlines, action items, and deliverables are completed on time.

The ideal candidate has extensive experience in operations and project coordination, with some executive assistant experience. This role is primarily focused on operational efficiency, project tracking, task follow-through, and administrative coordination rather than traditional executive assistance. Experience in construction, legal services, or a related professional services industry is a plus. A working understanding of bookkeeping, accounts receivable (AR), and accounts payable (AP) is also preferred.

* Project Management: Coordinate projects, monitor progress, track deliverables, and ensure deadlines are met.

* Task Management: Use Pto organize projects, assign and track tasks, monitor deadlines, and maintain project visibility.

* Executive Support: Provide administrative and executive assistance as needed, including scheduling, documentation, and follow-up communications.

* Process Documentation: Maintain SOPs, operational records, project documentation, and internal tracking systems.

* Financial Administration: Assist with basic bookkeeping tasks, invoice tracking, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and payment follow-ups.

* Reporting: Prepare progress updates, task summaries, and operational reports for management.

* Cross-Functional Coordination: Communicate with internal team members and external stakeholders to keep projects and business activities moving forward.





Qualifications

* Extensive experience in operations management, operations coordination, or project coordination.

* Previous executive assistant or administrative support experience.

* Hands-on experience using Asana for project and task management.

* Strong organizational, communication, and follow-through skills.

* Proven ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and priorities simultaneously.

* Working knowledge of bookkeeping, accounts receivable, and accounts payable.

* Experience in construction, legal services, or a related industry is highly desirable.

* Proficiency in common business tools, spreadsheets,
, and documentation platforms.

* Ability to work independently, anticipate operational needs, and take initiative in a remote environment.

* Strong attention to detail, accountability, and problem-solving skills.



Ideal Candidate Profile:

The ideal candidate is an operations-focused professional who can take ownership of projects, keep tasks moving, follow up consistently, and help management maintain visibility over business priorities.



We are looking for someone who is proactive, dependable, organized, and execution-oriented—someone who does not simply track tasks but ensures that action items are followed through to completion.





Application Requirements:

* Updated resume highlighting operations and project coordination experience.

* Summary of experience using Asana.

* Relevant experience in construction, legal services, or related industries.

* Overview of bookkeeping, AR, and AP responsibilities previously handled.

* Availability, expected compensation, and preferred working arrangement.

description:
News Writing Assistant

Pay: $600 a month



Hours: Monday to Friday, 7am to 3pm UK time (3pm to 11pm Philippine time).



Start: early to mid-November 2026



About us



We’re a UK news agency. We supply stories, photos and video to major news websites.



We need a careful writer for one task: turning a story our editors have chosen into a short news draft, using our template and AI tools.



For every story:



What we give you



1. The story, chosen by our news team

2. The source links, pictures and video

3. Our template, style guide and example stories

4. The AI and translation tools you need



What you do



1. Read everything in the package. Translate it with our tools where needed.

2. Write a short article draft in our template, with help from AI.

3. Check the draft against our accuracy checklist:

   1. Every name, date, place, number and quote matches the sources.

   2. The headline and story should only describe what the pictures or video actually show.

   3. For live stories, such as disasters or accidents, a quick search shows if numbers like the death toll have changed. Update the number and add a link to the new source so the editor can verify it.

4. Send the draft to the editor and list anything you’re unsure about.

5. An editor reviews every draft before it goes out and will ask questions if they arise.



Important: If sources disagree or something can’t be checked, never guess. Always flag it to an editor.



The day



1. 7 to 11am UK is the busiest time. Deadlines are tight and articles need to be written and checked quickly.

2. After 11am, you’ll help the team and learn new tasks.

3. Once you’re fully trained, the aim is to write five drafts a day.



What we’re looking for



1. Excellent written English

2. Careful reading. You notice when something doesn’t add up.

3. You ask when you’re not sure.

4. Quick, reliable replies on Slack



You don’t need to be a journalist. Writing, editing or research experience helps. You’ll show us your skills in the paid assessment.



You’ll need



1. Your own laptop

2. A reliable internet connection



If a storm, power cut or connection problem stops you working, tell your editor as soon as you can.



Sensitive material



Stories often involve crime, violence, accidents and deaths. Some pictures and video may be distressing. Only apply if you’re comfortable with this.



How to apply



1. Subject line: News Writing Assistant – [Your Full Name]

2. In around 150 words, in your own words, tell us:

   1. Your writing, editing or research experience

   2. Whether you can work 7am to 3pm UK time, Monday to Friday, and when you could start

   3. One thing you’d check before trusting a news story written by AI

3. If you have one, include an example of your writing or research. Say what you did, and whether you used AI.

4. You must end your application with the phrase “Checked and ready to file”.



What happens next



1. Paid assessment: shortlisted applicants get an AI-written article draft to check and correct against the sources. We’ll confirm the fee and time allowed before you start.

2. Paid pilot: successful applicants may be offered a limited paid pilot.

3. Regular work: if the pilot goes well for both sides, we’ll agree ongoing work.



We’ll assess:



- Your accuracy against the sources

- Your written English and use of the template and AI tool

- Whether you flag what’s unclear

- Your speed

- How much editing your draft needs

title: HIRING: Klaviyo Technician + Account Manager — Remote | DTC/eCom (Full-Time)
description:
HIRING: Klaviyo Technician + Account Manager — Remote | DTC/eCom (Full-Time)



eazyflows is a Klaviyo-focused
 marketing agency serving European DTC brands. We've built our own Claude ↔ Klaviyo automation system in-house, so most of the heavy manual work (flows, campaigns, segments, templates) is produced by the system — not clicked together by hand. We're looking for someone to operate that automation day-to-day, own account strategy, and keep our clients' Klaviyo accounts healthy and performing.



Because the system does the mechanical work, the actual hands-on effort is low — your value is in judgment, quality control, and client ownership, not clicking around Klaviyo for hours.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Run our Claude ↔ Klaviyo automation across 5+ DTC/eCom brands in parallel

- Quality-check every output: flow logic, segmentation, triggers, exclusions, trigger filters, timing

- Own each account's lifecycle strategy: roadmap, campaign calendar, flow priorities, performance review

- Catch integration, deliverability and tracking issues (Shopify ↔ Klaviyo, data sync, UTMs) before clients notice

- Run weekly account-health + strategy calls with the founder, later with clients directly



MUST-HAVES

- 2+ years hands-on Klaviyo in a DTC/eCom context (agency or multi-brand in-house)

- Deep in Klaviyo: flows, segmentation, campaigns, A/B tests, deliverability basics, Shopify integration

- Native/C1+ English

- Comfortable running AI-driven automations (Claude, ChatGPT) hands-on

- Available for weekly calls (Europe timezone)

- Full-time commitment, no parallel full-time job



COMPENSATION

- Base: €400/month (fixed)

- Because the Claude ↔ Klaviyo system does the heavy lifting, actual hands-on effort is low — this base reflects a lean operator seat, not a full build-everything-by-hand role

- After a 1-month trial: individual bonus structure, total comp up to 2× base depending on output and account results

- 100% remote



HOW TO APPLY — READ CAREFULLY



We've been doing this for a while and know exactly where Klaviyo setups quietly leak revenue or blow up on clients. Instead of jumping on a call and finding out you don't actually know the deep end, we want you to answer these 4 questions in writing before we even look at your CV.



Short answers are fine — we want to see how you think, not an essay. If you don't know the answer, say so honestly. "I'd Google it" is a better answer than making something up.



Start your reply with the word FREIHEIT. Applications without it get filtered out.



SCENARIO QUESTIONS (answer all 4)



1. A client's Welcome Flow is sending to people who already placed an order weeks ago. What are the 3 most likely causes, and how do you fix each one in Klaviyo?



2. An Abandoned Checkout Flow has an open rate of 65% but a conversion rate of 0.4%. The brand sells a €40 skincare product. Where would you look first, and what are 3 things you'd test?



3. A brand's deliverability dropped off a cliff over the last 2 weeks — open rates went from 42% to 18%. The sending domain is authenticated (SPF/DKIM/DMARC all green). Name 4 things you'd check, in order of priority.



4. A client wants an A/B test on an abandoned checkout
 subject line. Explain how you'd set it up in Klaviyo so the results are actually statistically meaningful — including what you'd test, sample size, and when you'd call the test.



ALSO TELL US

- 2–3 concrete DTC/eCom Klaviyo accounts you've owned (brand, what you built, what metrics moved — numbers please)

- How you use Claude or ChatGPT hands-on in your Klaviyo workflow today

- Your weekly availability + preferred working hours (Europe timezone sync required)

- Confirmation that €400/month base is in range for you (yes/no, be honest)



Send to 
 — subject line: FREIHEIT — Klaviyo Technician — [Your Name]



We read every application that starts with FREIHEIT. We ignore the rest.



Marcel

Founder, eazyflows

title: Closara: Technical Operator — GoHighLevel Weapon
description:
The Conversion OS · Complex Workflows · Voice AI · Lead Distribution · Snapshots at Scale



You don’t just use GoHighLevel. You bend it to your will. Here, that IS the job.



Remote · Full-time · AEST hours (10am–7pm Melbourne, 1hr lunch) · $1,000+ USD/mo base + ongoing per-account income + build-value bonus



The single most important technical hire we’ll make. Grow to $2,500+/mo as your book and your builds compound.



Read this part carefully — it’s a filter



We’re going to be blunt about what we need, because it saves us both time. We need a GoHighLevel absolute weapon. Not someone who “knows GHL” — someone who is genuinely one of the best in the business at it. The person who can look at a blank sub-account and, fast, wire up the most complex workflows, automations, sequences, pipelines and AI the platform can handle — and make it feel effortless.



The dream hire is a GHL master who is ALSO a genuine engineer — someone who can read an API doc for a system they’ve never seen and have it wired up the same day, and who ships real software with AI in the loop. GHL mastery is the non-negotiable spine of this role; deep engineering on top of it is what takes you from great to perfect for us. If you’re both, this ad was written for you.



This is NOT a follow-the-checklist job where someone hands you tickets. This is the steroid role at Closara: you own the machine end to end. The funnels that capture leads, the GHL builds that work them, the voice AI that calls them, the automations across every channel, the distribution that routes them to buyers, and the AI that keeps making all of it smarter.



If you’re a GHL master who gets a genuine kick out of building something complex and beautiful inside the platform — and replacing a $600/month tool with something better in two days — this could be the best role you’ve had.



We also want someone genuinely OBSESSED with AI. Not ‘has used ChatGPT’ — someone who follows the space, ships real software with AI in the loop, plays with new tools for fun, and gets excited about what dropped this week.



APPLICATION KEY — Start your application with the word “IGNITION” and one sentence on the most complex GoHighLevel system or automation you’ve built. Applications without it are deleted unread.



01 · What Closara Is



Closara is an Australian company that installs a complete lead-conversion system into sales-led businesses — the speed-to-lead follow-up, booking, reminder, distribution and reporting engine that makes sure no lead a business paid for ever slips through the cracks. It’s built on GoHighLevel, extended with custom automations and AI, and deployed from templated snapshots. We also run our own paid-lead and demand generation — sourcing leads and routing them to buyers in real time. Ground-floor, high-ownership seat — not a cog in a machine.



02 · What You’d Actually Own — The Machine



GoHighLevel is the heart of it. You build every piece to a standard most operators can’t touch:



GoHighLevel mastery, end to end — sub-accounts, snapshots, workflows, pipelines, custom fields and values, triggers, webhooks, calendars, forms, funnels, reputation, reporting. You know GHL cold and push it past where most people stop.

Complex automations and sequences — intricate, multi-branch, conditional workflows most people wouldn’t attempt. Speed-to-lead under 60 seconds, dormant reactivation, no-show recovery, smart escalation.

Every channel, mastered —
, SMS, voice, WhatsApp, and iMessage-style blue-bubble sending, all wired, warmed and delivered so the messaging lands like a real person, not a robot.

Voice AI — build and tune AI voice agents that answer, qualify and book inside 60 seconds (GHL native + Retell, Vapi, ElevenLabs). A core point of difference; you make it genuinely excellent.

Snapshots and repeatable client builds — turn our Conversion OS into a clean, duplicatable snapshot and deploy it sub-account after sub-account, fast and perfect every time.

AI agents and chatbots — conversational AI and agents woven into the pipeline, connected to Claude and other LLMs.

Lead distribution systems — route leads into buyer CRMs and dialers in real time: field mapping, daily caps, dedupe, retries when an endpoint goes down. Plumbing that cannot silently break.

Software integration — APIs and webhooks are your native language; read docs you’ve never seen and wire them same-day.

Build instead of buy — use Claude Code and AI to replace paid tools with software we own. Every subscription you kill shows up in your bonus.

Ongoing client management — keep each client’s system healthy; grow into 15+ sub-accounts as our systems mature.

Talk to clients like a pro — clear, calm, professional English, non-negotiable. You represent Closara.



03 · The Part That Makes This Role Special — AI Innovation



Our system has to STAY the best, and the market moves weekly. Scout relentlessly, ship with AI in the loop, test with judgment (prove it’s better before you roll it out), and promote the winners into the snapshot so every client benefits at once.



04 · What You Need



Must have — the non-negotiables:



GoHighLevel mastery — the heart of the role. Genuinely one of the best GHL builders out there: complex workflows, snapshots, sub-account management, custom values, webhook triggers, voice AI, multi-channel messaging. If you’re not a GHL weapon, this isn’t your seat. Tell us loudly and specifically what you’ve built.

Proven client management inside GHL — live client sub-accounts, real businesses depending on your builds. How many, what verticals, what you owned.

Speed and repeatability — complex things built fast, consistent, turned into snapshots others can run.

APIs and webhooks in your sleep — wire an unfamiliar system same-day.

Automation platforms — n8n, Make, Zapier or your own scripts.

Shipped real software with AI in the loop (Claude Code or similar) — production, not experiments.

A genuine obsession with AI, adaptable and self-directed, excellent written and spoken English, AEST hours (10am–7pm Melbourne, fixed), reliable setup.



The dream — what takes you from great to perfect (the same deep-engineering qualities we’d hire for on their own if they came with the GHL weapon attached):



Genuine software-engineer depth — senior developer / technical-lead calibre, not just a platform operator.

Voice technology depth — AI voice agents, dialers, telephony APIs.

Performance-marketing / media-buying exposure — pixels, Conversion API, tracking, attribution, UTM plumbing.

Lead-distribution / PPL experience — routing, caps, dupes, real-time posting.

You’ve written or improved SOPs — you think in systems.



05 · The Trial Task — Do This With Your Application



TASK A — Speed-to-lead build: A solar installer’s website form was filled at 9pm Sunday. In GHL, describe (and if you can, build in a free trial + screen-record) how you’d get that lead a text,
 AND call attempt within 60 seconds, 24/7 — and what happens if they don’t book.



TASK B — Integration / distribution build: A lead must be posted in real time to a buyer’s CRM via their API — field mapping, daily cap, dedupe, and a retry if the endpoint’s down. Describe/build how you’d wire it with GHL + n8n / Make / scripts, and how you’d know when it breaks.



Bonus: One AI tool that recently impressed you + how you’d use it to make a system like ours better — or one paid tool you’d replace by building it yourself.



Process: Review → short trial project → one call with Sasha → paid trial month + onboarding. Can move in days.



06 · The Money — And Why It Grows



Base: $1,000+ USD/mo, full-time, paid reliably (higher for exceptional proven depth). We expect you to put in the work and sometimes that will require longer hours

Per-account income — the spine: +$100 USD/mo per client you install and keep healthy past their 90-day term, every month they stay satisfied. Compounds as your book grows.

Build-value bonus — the accelerator: tied to value shipped — systems built, paid tools replaced, revenue unblocked.

Trajectory: $2,500+ USD/mo realistic around the 6-month mark. Honest ramp: first couple of months sit closer to base while you build the book.

Plus: real ownership, report to the founder directly, get in early and lead the next hires, a clean well-architected system, long-term by design.



How to apply: (1) “IGNITION” + one sentence on your most complex GHL build; (2) Task A or B; (3) your GHL + technical background with one specific example and how many live client accounts you’ve managed; (4) links — portfolio, GitHub, Loom; (5) a 60–90s English video intro + AEST availability.

title: HIRING: Email Designer — Remote | DTC/eCom (Full-Time)
description:
HIRING:
 Designer — Remote | DTC/eCom (Full-Time)



eazyflows is a Klaviyo-focused
 marketing agency serving European DTC brands. We're looking for a Figma-native
 designer who can produce clean, on-brand, conversion-focused
 designs at agency pace, across multiple brands in parallel.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Design 3+ campaigns per week per brand + flow
s as needed, across 5 brands in parallel

- Work from briefs: brand guidelines, campaign angle, copy — turn them into Figma
 designs ready for Klaviyo hand-off

- Weekly design research: scan what strong DTC brands are shipping right now, pull references, feed new ideas and visual directions into our workflow

- Produce the AI visual content used inside flow and campaign
s — hero visuals, product imagery, mood images, and infographic-style assets we use to explain concepts visually instead of with long copy

- Build designs that are visual-first: every section carries a visual element, not just the hero

- Produce designs that read as one system per brand (consistent, on-brand, mobile-first)

- Hand off cleanly to the Klaviyo side (clear structure, labelled layers, specs)

- Weekly calls with the founder to align on priorities and feedback



MUST-HAVES

- 2+ years as a designer in an agency context (not only in-house or solo-freelance)

- Figma-native — you live in Figma, not Canva

- Portfolio with real DTC/eCom work (not spec/mock-ups only)

- Daily hands-on use of AI image generation tools (name them specifically in your application)

- Native/C1+ English

- Available for weekly calls (Europe timezone)

- Full-time commitment, no parallel full-time job



COMPENSATION

- Base: €1.000/month (fixed)

- After a 1-month trial: individual bonus structure, total comp up to 2× base depending on output and quality

- 100% remote



HOW TO APPLY — READ CAREFULLY



We have a specific way of thinking about
 design. We don't want to spell it out in the job post — we want to see whether you already think this way, in your own words. Before we even look at your CV, answer these 4 questions in writing.



Short answers are fine. We want to see how you think, not an essay. There are no "correct" buzzwords here — give us your honest take.



Start your reply with the word FREIHEIT. Applications without it get filtered out.



SCENARIO QUESTIONS (answer all 4)



1. Most subscribers skim an
 in about 3 seconds before d
 whether to actually read it or scroll on. How does that fact shape the way you design? Walk us through 3–4 concrete design choices you make specifically for the skimmer.



2. A copywriter sends you a flow
 with 4 sections, each with a dense paragraph of body copy under the headline. You still need the subscriber to walk away with the key message. What do you push back on, and what design techniques do you reach for to make it work?



3. Imagine a client in a vertical that genuinely requires some explanation — think supplements, skincare, finance, or a technical product. The copy is informative and necessary, but you don't want the subscriber to feel like they're reading a wall of text. What's your default move to carry the message? Give an example from past work if you can.



4. Think about a single section of an
 — a product block, a benefit block, a "how it works" block. In your view, what makes that section pull its weight visually, and what are the mistakes you see designers make most often at the section level?



ALSO TELL US

- Portfolio link (3–5 concrete DTC/eCom
 examples — brand, your role, what you designed)

- Which AI image generation tools you use hands-on day-to-day, and how (name them, don't say "AI tools")

- Your weekly availability + preferred working hours (Europe timezone sync required)

- Confirmation that €1.000/month base is in range for you (yes/no, be honest)



Send to 
 — subject line: FREIHEIT —
 Designer — [Your Name]



We read every application that starts with FREIHEIT. We ignore the rest.



Marcel

Founder, eazyflows

title: Digital & E-commerce Assistant
description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY



Scriveiner is an award-winning British luxury brand specialising in writing instruments and premium accessories. We serve millions of customers worldwide through major online marketplaces and more than 1,000 retail stores globally.



We are the flagship brand of Infinity Brands, a founder-led, high-growth business building premium consumer brands with global reach.



HOW TO APPLY



Please complete this application form:



ABOUT THE ROLE



We’re looking for a Digital & E-commerce Assistant to help keep our Shopify store running smoothly and support the growth of our online sales.



You’ll work with our Senior Digital & E-commerce Manager on product listings, website updates, campaign support, and performance reporting. You may also provide occasional support with Amazon.



This is a hands-on, junior role for someone organised and detail-minded who enjoys online retail and wants to develop their e-commerce skills.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



1. Shopify store and product content

- Upload and update Shopify products, including titles, descriptions, images, prices, variants, and stock details

- Write and edit product copy, meta titles, and meta descriptions

- Resize and prepare product images to meet brand and platform requirements

- Check the website regularly for broken links, incorrect prices, out-of-stock items, and checkout issues

- Set up promotions, discount codes, collections, and homepage banners for campaigns



2. Amazon support

- Update Amazon listings and catalogue information when needed

- Help monitor listing performance, reviews, and compliance



3. Digital marketing support

- Help prepare and schedule
 campaigns and automated flows

- Coordinate campaign assets with designers, photographers, and agencies

- Support campaigns across other digital channels as needed



4. Reporting and operations

- Prepare weekly sales and traffic reports using Shopify analytics and Google Analytics 4

- Track key measures such as conversion rate, average order value, traffic sources, and
 performance

- Coordinate with customer service and warehouse teams about orders, returns, and stock issues



WHAT YOU'LL NEED



These are essential requirements. Please apply only if you have practical, hands-on experience with all three:

- Shopify, including product uploads, collections, discounts, and website content

- Amazon Seller Central, including listing or catalogue management

- Google Analytics 4, including checking traffic or sales data and preparing reports



You should also have:

- 1–2 years of experience in e-commerce or online retail

- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including filters, lookups, and pivot tables

- Clear, accurate writing and close attention to detail

- The ability to organise your own work, meet deadlines, and work independently from home

- Basic HTML skills for simple text formatting

- A practical, proactive approach to solving problems



HELPFUL EXPERIENCE



These are an advantage, but they are not required:

- Klaviyo

- Meta Ads Manager

- Google Ads

- Matrixify for bulk product edits or product management



HOW TO APPLY



Please complete this application form:



You’ll be asked to provide your CV and a short video introduction. In your video, please briefly cover:

1. Your e-commerce or online retail experience

2. One example of a product listing or Shopify store update you handled yourself

3. Your experience using Amazon Seller Central

4. How you have used GA4 to check traffic or sales and report what you found

5. Short note on an online store you admire (and one thing you'd improve)

6. Why this role interests you



Please describe your own work and be specific about what you did. You do not need to share confidential company information or account access. Applications without a CV, video introduction, or hands-on experience with Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, and GA4 will not be considered.



HIRING STAGES

Stage 1 > Application form (CV and Video Introduction)

Stage 2 > Role Assessment and walkthrough

Stage 3 > Culture Fit Interview

Stage 4 > Main Interview

Stage 5 > Character Reference

Stage 6 > Offer

title: Part-Time Property Management Bookkeeper / Accounts Assistant
description:
Employment Type: Part-Time, Long-Term

Working Hours: 20 hours per week (4 hours per day, Monday–Friday)

Salary: USD $400 per month

Working Schedule: Preferably with availability during UK business hours



About Us



We are a UK-based property management company specialising in residential block management and commercial property service charge administration.



We are looking for a reliable, detail-oriented and organised Property Management Bookkeeper / Accounts Assistant to support our growing property management portfolio.



The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, reconciling transactions, monitoring property expenditure and assisting with the preparation of annual service charge budgets and financial reports.



This is a long-term remote opportunity for someone who enjoys working with numbers, has strong attention to detail and can work independently.



Key Responsibilities



1. Bank Reconciliations and Transaction Processing



Reconcile bank transactions against property management accounting records.



Match incoming service charge payments to individual tenant accounts.



Record and categorise expenditure, including contractor invoices, insurance premiums, utilities and maintenance costs.



Investigate discrepancies between bank statements and accounting records.



Maintain accurate financial ledgers for individual properties.



2. Service Charge Accounting



Maintain service charge income and expenditure records for residential and commercial properties.



Allocate expenditure to appropriate buildings, accounting periods and service charge schedules.



Monitor outstanding tenant balances and prepare arrears reports.



Assist with establishing opening balances when taking over management of new properties.



Prepare financial information and supporting schedules for year-end service charge accounts.



3. Budget Preparation and Financial Reporting



Assist with preparing annual property service charge budgets.



Review historical expenditure and prepare expenditure forecasts.



Prepare budget-versus-actual expenditure reports.



Maintain reserve fund and sinking fund schedules.



Prepare monthly financial summaries for management review.



Identify unusual expenditure, accounting discrepancies and potential budget shortfalls.



4. Property Management Administration



Maintain organised digital records of invoices, receipts, statements and financial documentation.



Update property management accounting software.



Liaise with management regarding missing invoices, discrepancies and outstanding information.



Support general property management accounting and administrative tasks when required.



Required Qualifications and Experience



Minimum 2 years of experience in bookkeeping, accounting or financial administration.



Excellent Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills.



Experience performing bank reconciliations and maintaining financial ledgers.



Experience preparing financial reports and budgets.



Good written and spoken English.



Strong organisational skills and exceptional attention to detail.



Ability to work independently, meet deadlines and maintain confidentiality.



Reliable internet connection and a suitable home working environment.



Highly Desirable (But Not Essential)



1. Previous experience working with UK property management companies.



2. Understanding of residential service charges, tenant accounting and client money reconciliation.



3. Experience with property management software such as BlocksOnline, Arthur, Re-Leased, Yardi or similar.



4. Experience with Xero, QuickBooks or comparable accounting systems.



5. Familiarity with UK financial reporting and property management terminology.



Training will be provided on our specific property management software and internal procedures.



Salary and Working Arrangements



Salary: USD $400 per month.



Hours: 20 hours per week.



Schedule: Monday to Friday, approximately 4 hours per day.



Location: Fully remote, working from the Philippines.



Contract: Long-term opportunity, subject to satisfactory performance.



Training: Initial onboarding and software training provided.



Career Development: Opportunity to take on additional responsibilities as the company grows.



How to Apply



Please submit the following:



1. Your updated CV or résumé.



2. A brief introduction describing your relevant bookkeeping or accounting experience.



3. Details of any experience working with UK companies or property management businesses.



4. The accounting or property management software you have previously used.



5. Your availability to work during UK business hours.



We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Finance & NetSuite Specialist – Full-Time Remote
description:

Full-time, permanent work-from-home position



Stable, long-term opportunity supporting a U.S.-based company

Opportunities for professional growth and performance-based pay increases

You’ll support an upcoming NetSuite implementation while helping manage day-to-day financial operations and payroll processes. Identify opportunities to improve financial workflows, reporting accuracy, and internal controls



Protect confidential financial, company, and employee information

Advanced, hands-on NetSuite proficiency, with substantial experience using its core accounting and finance functions



Ability to work independently in NetSuite, investigate transaction discrepancies, troubleshoot workflow issues, and produce accurate reports



Strong working knowledge of NetSuite saved searches, financial reporting, CSV imports, and dashboards



Direct involvement in at least one NetSuite implementation or migration, with personal responsibility for data preparation, validation, testing, or rollout support



Strong understanding of accounts payable, accounts receivable, the general ledger, and financial statements



Practical payroll experience, including reviewing payroll information, resolving discrepancies, and reconciling payroll entries



Strong Excel skills, including lookups, pivot tables, and reconciling information across multiple files or reports



Excellent written and spoken English



Ability to explain financial and system issues clearly and communicate confidently with a U.S.-based team



Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and consistent follow-through



Ability to manage recurring finance deadlines alongside implementation tasks



Reliable internet and a quiet, private workspace



Availability to work the full U.S. Eastern Time schedule listed below



Applicants should have substantial hands-on NetSuite experience beyond basic data entry or viewing reports.



Preferred Qualifications:



Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or a related field



Previous experience supporting U.S.-based businesses



Experience reconciling financial information between a previous accounting system and NetSuite



Familiarity with U.S. payroll processes and payroll platforms



Experience documenting financial procedures and training colleagues



Relevant accounting qualification or NetSuite certification

Someone who knows NetSuite well and brings equally strong finance skills. You understand how transactions flow through the accounts, can recognize when a balance is incorrect, and know how to investigate and resolve the issue.



You’re comfortable supporting an implementation while keeping everyday finance and payroll responsibilities moving. You take ownership, ask thoughtful questions, communicate early, and follow through until the work is complete.

NetSuite | Accounting & Finance | Payroll | Financial Reporting | Microsoft Excel

title: Software Engineer
description:
About the Role

We're looking for a Full-Stack Software Engineer with a front-end focus to join our client's growing engineering team.



This is a hands-on role for an engineer who is comfortable working across the stack and taking ownership of features from start to finish. While the role has a strong front-end focus, we're looking for someone who is comfortable contributing beyond the UI and working across backend services, integrations, and supporting systems.



You'll work closely with Product, Design, and Engineering to turn requirements and ideas into reliable, high-quality software. You'll have the opportunity to contribute not only to how features work, but also to how they look, feel, and work for the end user.



This role is well suited to an engineer who combines strong technical skills with product thinking, design awareness, and good judgement.







Key Responsibilities

Full-Stack Software Development



Design, develop, test, and maintain software across the front-end and backend.

Own features end to end, from understanding requirements and planning through development, testing, deployment, and refinement.

Build reliable, maintainable, and performant software.

Contribute to backend services, APIs, integrations, and supporting systems.

Work closely with Product and Design to translate requirements and concepts into high-quality technical solutions.

Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues across the application stack.

Contribute to improving the reliability, performance, and maintainability of existing systems.

Front-End Development & Product Experience



Build polished, intuitive, and responsive user experiences.

Translate UX/UI concepts and mockups into production-ready features.

Apply strong product and design judgement rather than simply implementing designs pixel for pixel.

Identify opportunities to improve usability, clarity, consistency, and the overall user experience.

Make thoughtful improvements while respecting agreed requirements, scope, timelines, and other fixed constraints.

Balance technical quality, user experience, and practical delivery requirements.

Backend & Systems Development



Develop and maintain backend services and supporting systems.

Build and maintain APIs, integrations, scheduled processes, and other technical components as required.

Ensure software is robust, performant, scalable, and maintainable.

Contribute to reliable deployment processes and cloud-based infrastructure.

Investigate and resolve technical issues across the application stack.

Support ongoing improvements to existing systems, processes, and technical workflows.

Product Delivery & Prioritisation



Work with Product, Design, and Engineering stakeholders to understand priorities and deliver against requirements.

Prioritise critical functionality and ensure key requirements are delivered first.

Recognise when additional polish or enhancements can be addressed after core functionality is delivered.

Flag blockers, risks, dependencies, and potential delivery issues early.

Communicate proactively about progress, challenges, and anything that may affect delivery.

Take ownership of assigned features and see them through to completion.

Make practical decisions that balance product quality, technical considerations, and delivery requirements.

Team Collaboration



Participate in planning sessions, code reviews, technical discussions, and other engineering activities.

Collaborate closely with Product and Design to ensure technical solutions meet both functional and user experience requirements.

Share ideas and propose technical improvements to existing systems and workflows.

Contribute to a positive, collaborative, and accountable engineering environment.

Be responsive, reliable, and easy for teammates to work with.

Communicate clearly and respectfully with team members and stakeholders.





Other Responsibilities



Make necessary process suggestions and improvements which can help the team.

Contributes to team effort by accomplishing related results as needed.

Perform other related tasks and duties that may be assigned by the client later on.



About You

We're looking for an engineer who combines strong technical capability with product thinking, design awareness, ownership, and good judgement.



Essential Experience & Skills



2–4 years of professional Software Engineer experience.

Strong full-stack development experience with a front-end leaning.

Solid background in software development and system design.

Experience building and shipping modern web applications.

Experience working across both front-end and backend systems.

Experience working with modern programming languages, cloud infrastructure, and deployment environments.

Experience working closely with Product and Design teams to bring requirements and product ideas to life.

Strong understanding of modern front-end development practices.

Strong attention to detail while maintaining awareness of priorities and delivery requirements.

Ability to own features end to end and work independently.

Strong communication and collaboration skills.

Ability to identify and communicate blockers early.

Product & Design Mindset

What sets the right person apart is a strong product and design eye. You should be able to take a mockup and make it noticeably better instead of copying it pixel for pixel, while still treating copy, legal, scope and deadlines as fixed.



You should understand how to prioritise delivery effectively — shipping what's critical for go-live first and polishing later where appropriate.



You should also be proactive in your communication: flag blockers early and be easy to reach when collaboration or decisions are needed.



Personal Attributes



Product-minded and genuinely interested in how software works and feels for the end user.

Strong eye for detail and quality.

Practical and outcome-focused.

Comfortable making thoughtful decisions when requirements are fixed but there is room to improve the implementation.

Able to distinguish between what is critical for go-live and what can be refined later.

Proactive in raising blockers and risks.

Reliable, responsive, and accountable.

Easy to reach and easy to work with.

Collaborative and respectful when working with Product, Design, and Engineering teammates.

Comfortable working independently while keeping relevant stakeholders informed.

Takes ownership and follows through on commitments.





What You'll Bring



The ideal candidate is a full-stack engineer who leans front-end and enjoys having meaningful ownership over the products they build.



You'll bring strong engineering fundamentals along with an appreciation for product quality and user experience. You won't simply implement a mockup exactly as provided — you'll understand the intent behind it and use your own product and design judgement to make the end result better, while respecting the requirements and constraints that cannot change.



Most importantly, you'll be someone the team can rely on — proactive in communication, quick to flag blockers, easy to reach, accountable for your work, and comfortable taking ownership of a feature from idea through to production.

title: Experienced Bookkeeper for Australian Accounting Practice
description:
EXPERIENCED BOOKKEEPER for AUSTRALIAN Accounting Firm



###   Are you ready to show us your Australian bookkeeping superpowers?

###   We’re excited to meet the right person — is it you?



We are offering an outstanding opportunity for an experienced Bookkeeper with a solid background in the bookkeeping environment and proficiency in QuickBooks Online and Xero. Join our growing team and deliver high-quality results by following clearly documented systems in a supportive and efficient workplace.  

Experience with Australian GST is essential. 

Join a values-driven accounting team with extra Easter leave available, and a two-week Christmas shutdown!



A. THE ROLE

We are seeking a detail-driven, client-focused bookkeeper who enjoys making a real difference to small businesses. You will be working in a structured, process-oriented environment, where accuracy, productivity and client service are key.

# Client Service Mantra: ACE — Accurate, Cost-effective, and Efficient

# Work Schedule: Monday to Thursday (8:00 am – 5:30 pm AEST, GMT +10) and four hours on Friday



THE ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU IF YOU:

*   Hold formal training in Accounting or Bookkeeping

*   Have SOLID experience in Australian BAS preparation 

*    Understand Australian GST legislation and nuances

*    Love to work as a team with all team members following consistent processes.

*    Love to deliver high-quality work, on time

*    Have a strong grasp of accounting principles and general ledger

*    Communicate clearly in excellent written and spoken English

*    Embrace productivity tools and cloud-based technology (especially QuickBooks Online)

*    Are proactive, solution-focused, and love following procedures

*    Are organised, self-directed, and an efficient time manager

*    Have a strong sense of professional confidentiality and responsibility

*    Can work well under pressure and in a remote team setting

*    Are complimented on your attention to detail and reliability



B.  CORE RESPONSIBILITIES



You’ll work as part of a small, collaborative team, and will be responsible for:

• Bookkeeping and transaction processing for small business clients

• Accurate general ledger and GST allocations

• Bank reconciliation and review of outstanding transactions

• Preparation of Business Activity Statements (BAS)

• Preparation of year-end workpapers for our accountants



Required Skills & Attributes:



• A genuine passion for accounting and numbers

• Strong understanding of debits and credits (this will be tested)

• Ability to follow procedures and grasp the "why" behind tasks

• Strong communication and collaboration skills

• Tech-savviness — advanced computer skills will be tested



C.  EQUIPMENT REQUIREMENTS



To be considered, you must have:

## A reliable computer (i5 processor or higher) with minimum 8GB RAM preferable MORE.

## At least TO screens, preferably THREE — ideally a laptop + 2 extra screens or a dual-monitor setup

##  A stable internet connection and a reliable internet backup

## A dedicated home workspace with ergonomic chair and proper desk, away from household interruptions 

## A dedicated noise-cancelling headset (not shared)

## A camera for meetings

## A full keyboard with number pad and mouse

## The hard disk of your computer MUST be less than 80% full



D CHILDCARE ARRANGEMENTS



For applicants with children under 8 years old, a dedicated adult carer must be present during all working hours.



E. WHO ARE WE?



We are a tech-forward, Australian-based accounting firm that supports small businesses across the country. 



We value:

 #  Clear communication

#  A love of learning

#  Commitment to maintaining established procedures and processes

#  Confidentiality and integrity

#  Strong teamwork, even in a remote environment



We have well-documented procedures available in our online portal.



F. WORK SCHEDULE, HOLIDAYS & BENEFITS



## 40 hours per week – Monday to Thursday GMT +10 8:00 am to 5:30 pm and 4 hours on Friday morning. 

      (6:00 am to 2:30 pm Philippine time 

## Pro-rata Annual Leave (7%) and Personal Leave (3.5%)

## 2-week Christmas Shutdown 

## Easter Thursday leave available; 1 & 2 November leave available

## Paid for all gazetted Brisbane (Australia) Public Holidays

## Paid every second week in PHP directly to your bank account

## 13th Month Pay (pro-rata after 6 months service)



Pay is commensurate with experience and reviewed regularly.



G. HOW TO GET OUR ATTENTION



We only shortlist applicants who follow these instructions exactly. Please include all four items below in your application:



1)  Subject Line



Your application
 must have the exact subject line:  “Bookkeeper Superstar -  ”

## This is essential to get past our screening filters.



2)  RESUME



Submit a detailed resume listing all work and study over the past 5 years, plus a summary of prior experience.

### DO NOT send Canva-style 1-page designs. We want substance over style.



3) COVER LETTER



In your letter, tell us:



a)  When and how you discovered your passion for bookkeeping

b)  What a satisfying day at work looks like for you

c)  An example of how tech improved your work/study

d)  How you manage tasks and deadlines

e)  Details of your QuickBooks Online experience

f)  Your understanding of Australian GST — and how you’ve applied it

g)  The best thing you’ve done in Word and Excel — and how it added value

h)  Your favourite subject studied and how you excelled in it

i)   A time you used English professionally with non-Filipino clients/teams

j)  An example of your “can-do” attitude solving a problem

k)  What excites you about working from home

l)  Your expected salary (in PHP) for a 80-hour fortnight



4)  SHORT VIDEO



Make a 30–60 second video using your mobile phone showing your dedicated workspace.

Tell us:

a) How your setup makes you productive

b) How you will keep it confidential from others in your household

title: Lead Manager / Appointment Specialist (Football Placement & Athlete Support)
description:
Job Title: Lead Manager / Appointment Specialist (Football Placement & Athlete Support)



Type: Full-time | Remote



Salary/Earnings: PHP 15,000 Base Pay + Performance Bonuses (Target Earnings: PHP 15,000 - PHP 29,000+ / month)



About the Role

FutXPerform (FXP) is an international sports placement and career development platform dedicated to helping promising football players take the next step toward joining our elite development and pathway programmes.



We are looking for a organized, persuasive, and proactive Lead Manager / Appointment Specialist to manage lead conversations from first contact through to a qualified, attended consultation with our sales team.



This role is ideal for someone who excels at building trust with young athletes and parents, asking thoughtful qualifying questions, staying highly organized, and following through consistently.



What You’ll Do

* Outreach & Lead Engagement: Engage potential players through approved outreach channels and respond promptly to incoming enquiries.

* Qualification & Discovery: Learn each player’s football background, goals, and current circumstances to assess fit for an FXP programme.

* Clear Expectations: Explain our programmes and next steps clearly and accurately (without making false promises regarding contracts, trials, or guaranteed placements).

* Persistent Follow-Up: Nurture interested players, answer preliminary questions, and ensure they are well-prepared for their scheduled consultation.

* Appointment Setting & Attendance: Coordinate bookings and send timely reminders to maximize show-up rates. Involve parents or guardians in the conversation whenever appropriate.

* CRM Management: Maintain detailed lead records, log call outcomes, and brief the sales team with key player context prior to booked calls.

* Process Improvement: Share recurring questions, common player objections, and lead trends with the core team to refine messaging and conversion rates.



What We’re Looking For

* Communication: Exceptional written and spoken English with a warm, empathetic, and confident tone.

* Relevant Experience: Background in lead qualification, recruitment outreach, appointment setting, or sales support.

* High Standards: Solid judgment on who qualifies as a high-fit lead for our sales team.

* Systems & Targets: Comfortable managing leads in a CRM and consistently hitting performance metrics.

* Domain Interest: A background, interest, or passion for football (soccer) is a huge advantage.



Compensation & Performance Incentive Structure

We offer a stable monthly base salary paired with generous performance-based incentives for qualified scheduled calls and closed enrollments.



* Base Salary: PHP 15,000 / month

*Per Qualified Attended Call: PHP 200 / call

* Per Closed Sale/Enrollment: PHP 2,500 / closed client

* Total Earning Potential: PHP 15,000 – PHP 29,000+ per month



Scenario Breakdown (Example Target Month):

Assuming 20 qualified calls attend their scheduled call with a 20% close rate (4 closed sales):



* Base Salary: PHP 15,000

* 20 Attended Calls: PHP 4,000 (20 x PHP 200)

* 4 Closed Sales: PHP 10,000 (4 x PHP 2,500)

* Total Monthly Payout: PHP 29,000 or More depends on your closing rate

title: Data Developer - 6 months Fixed Term Contract
description:
***PLEASE READ ON HOW TO APPLY***



Job Title: Data Developer  - 6 months Fixed Term Contract

Location: Remote | Philippines based ONLY

Salary Range: Php 190,000 per month

A MUST: Minimum of 5 years of solid experience



Data Engineer – Snowflake / Python / PySpark 



About the Role

We're looking for a Data Engineer to join our data team and own the ingestion, pipelines,

and infrastructure that get raw data reliably into our warehouse and ready for use. This role

is primarily focused on building and maintaining the data pipeline layer - ingesting data from

source systems, orchestrating workflows, and ensuring data lands in Snowflake accurately,

on time, and at scale.



What You'll Do

● Design, build, and own end-to-end data pipelines that ingest data from a wide range

of source systems (databases, APIs, event streams, third-party files) into our data

warehouse

● Build and maintain reliable ingestion frameworks that handle batch and/or streaming

data at scale

● Use Python and PySpark to build scalable extraction and processing jobs, including

large-scale/distributed data processing

● Build, schedule, and monitor pipelines using an orchestration tool, including

dependency management, retries, alerting, and SLAs

● Write efficient, production-grade SQL for data transformation, validation, and

troubleshooting across the pipeline

● Maintain dbt models where needed to support standardized, tested transformations

downstream of ingestion

● Implement data quality checks, monitoring, and alerting to catch pipeline failures and

data issues before they hit downstream consumers

● Partner with Product owners, data analysts, and software engineers to understand

upstream source systems and downstream data needs

● Contribute to data infrastructure and architecture decisions (e.g., ingestion patterns,

storage layout, orchestration strategy)

● Maintain clear documentation of pipeline architecture & data lineage



What We're Looking For

● Proven experience building and maintaining production data pipelines end-to-end,

from ingestion through delivery

● 5+ years of hands-on experience working with Snowflake (or a similar cloud data

warehouse) in a production environment

● Strong proficiency in Python for building ingestion jobs, automation, and data

processing

● Experience with PySpark for distributed data processing at scale

● Hands-on experience with a workflow orchestration tool (e.g., Apache Airflow,

Dagster, Prefect, or similar) for scheduling and monitoring pipelines

● Strong SQL skills for data transformation, debugging, and validation

● Working knowledge of dbt for downstream transformation and testing

● Experience integrating with diverse data sources (relational databases, REST APIs,

event/streaming systems, flat files)

● Understanding of data pipeline reliability practices: retries, idempotency, monitoring,

and alerting

● Comfort working in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities

● Strong communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally with analytics,

engineering, and business stakeholders



Nice to Have

● Experience with streaming/event-based ingestion (Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub, or

similar)

● Experience with CI/CD for data pipelines

● Experience with version control (Git) and code review workflows

● Background in a cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure)

● Experience working in an agile data team environment



***PLEASE READ ON HOW TO APPLY***



How to Apply:

To apply for this role, please submit a link to your resume and a brief Loom video (max 2 minutes) introducing yourself and highlighting your skills relevant to the role. In your video, please address the following:

- A short introduction of yourself and why you're interested in this role.

- Your current and previous experience as a Data Engineer and specific experience with Snowflake / Python / PySpark

- Key skills or qualifications that make you a strong fit for this position.



Please note: Applications without a video will not be reviewed. We look forward to welcoming a passionate developer who prioritizes clean code, performance optimization, and delivering exceptional user experiences.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
About the Role



We are looking for a proactive and tech-savvy Social Media Manager to build, organize, manage, and automate our social media presence across multiple platforms.



This role goes beyond simply creating and posting content. The ideal candidate will be responsible for establishing a strong and consistent Rate DNA presence across social platforms, connecting our accounts and marketing tools, creating efficient workflows, and automating repetitive tasks wherever possible.



You will help build a social media system that is organized, scalable, responsive, and designed to generate engagement and qualified leads with minimal manual effort.



Platforms

The Social Media Manager will manage and/or establish Rate DNA's presence on platforms including:

-

- Instagram

- Threads

- LinkedIn

- TikTok

- X 
)

- Nextdoor

- Google Business Profile

- Alignable

- Other relevant social and business platforms as needed



Key Responsibilities

1. Social Media Account Setup & Management

- Create, claim, verify, and optimize Rate DNA profiles across all relevant platforms.

- Ensure all accounts use consistent branding, company information, contact details, logos, descriptions, and visual identity.

- Secure accounts using appropriate passwords, permissions, two-factor authentication, and administrator access.

- Maintain an organized record of account access, ownership, and platform credentials.

- Identify additional platforms and directories that may benefit Rate DNA's online presence.

2. Social Media Management & Scheduling

- Set up and maintain a centralized social media scheduling and management system using tools such as Meta Business Suite, Buffer, Hootsuite, or similar platforms.

- Build and maintain a monthly content calendar.

- Schedule content across multiple platforms while adapting posts to each platform's format and audience.

- Maintain a consistent posting schedule.

- Monitor scheduled content and troubleshoot publishing issues.

3. Content Creation

- Create engaging social media posts relevant to mortgage, real estate, home financing, interest rates, and related topics.

- Develop graphics using Canva or similar design tools.

- Create and edit short-form videos for platforms such as Instagram Reels, TikTok,
, and YouTube Shorts when applicable.

- Repurpose existing content into multiple formats and platforms.

- Develop educational, promotional, community-focused, and lead-generation content.

- Maintain consistent Rate DNA branding and messaging across all content.

4. Social Media Automation

- Identify repetitive social media and marketing tasks that can be automated.

- Build and maintain workflows for:

- Cross-posting

- Content scheduling

- Automated responses

- DM triggers

- Lead notifications

- Lead routing

- CRM updates

- Internal team notifications

- Connect social media platforms with CRM and other business systems using tools such as Zapier, Make, or similar automation platforms.

- Test automations regularly and troubleshoot failed workflows.

- Continuously look for ways to reduce manual work while maintaining quality and personalization.

5. Lead Management & Routing

- Monitor comments, direct messages, inquiries, and social media leads.

- Respond to basic inquiries promptly and professionally.

- Identify potential sales leads and route them to the appropriate team member or CRM.

- Ensure lead information is captured accurately.

- Create automated lead-routing workflows where appropriate.

- Track the source of leads generated through social media.

6. Community Management

- Monitor comments, mentions, reviews, and messages across platforms.

- Respond to customers and prospects in a professional, helpful, and timely manner.

- Escalate questions or complaints that require management or specialized assistance.

- Monitor brand mentions and relevant conversations.

- Maintain a positive and professional online presence for Rate DNA.

7. Mortgage & Real Estate Compliance

- Ensure social media content follows applicable mortgage and real estate advertising requirements.

- Follow company guidelines regarding NMLS information, Equal Housing Opportunity requirements, disclosures, licensing information, and advertising language.

- Review content for compliance before publishing.

- Work with management/compliance personnel when clarification or approval is required.

- Stay informed about company-specific marketing and compliance requirements.

8. Analytics & Reporting

- Monitor social media performance across platforms.

- Track key metrics including:

- Engagement

- Followers and audience growth

- Reach and impressions

- Website traffic

- Leads generated

- Messages and inquiries

- Content performance

- Prepare a monthly social media performance report.

- Identify top-performing content and opportunities for improvement.

- Provide recommendations based on data and performance trends.

9. Continuous Improvement

- Research new social media features, tools, automation opportunities, and emerging platforms.

- Recommend new tools or workflows that can improve efficiency.

- Test new content formats and strategies.

- Continuously improve Rate DNA's social media presence and lead-generation process.

- Stay current with changes to platform algorithms, policies, and best practices.



Required Qualifications

- 2+ years of experience in social media management, digital marketing, or a related role.

- Strong experience managing multiple social media platforms.

- Experience creating social media content, graphics, and short-form videos.

- Experience with social media scheduling and management platforms.

- Strong understanding of social media marketing and audience engagement.

- Experience with automation tools such as Zapier, Make, or similar platforms.

- Experience connecting social media platforms with CRMs or other business applications.

- Strong organizational and time-management skills.

- Excellent written English and communication skills.

- Strong attention to detail.

- Ability to work independently and manage multiple platforms simultaneously.

- Ability to troubleshoot basic technical and automation issues.



Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working with a mortgage, real estate, financial services, or related company.

- Knowledge of mortgage and real estate advertising compliance.

- Experience with NMLS and Equal Housing requirements.

- Experience with CRM platforms and lead-routing systems.

- Experience with Canva, CapCut, Adobe Express, or similar creative tools.

- Experience with Google Business Profile.

Ideal Candidate

- Tech-savvy and comfortable learning new platforms.

- Automation-minded and always looking for ways to eliminate repetitive manual work.

- Creative and able to produce engaging content.

- Proactive rather than waiting to be told what to do.

- Detail-oriented, especially when managing multiple accounts and automations.

- Organized and capable of maintaining a clear content calendar and workflow.

- Analytical and able to use data to improve performance.

Working Relationship

The Social Media Manager will work closely with management, marketing, sales, and other team members to ensure that social media activity supports Rate DNA's overall marketing and lead-generation goals.

The successful candidate should be comfortable taking ownership of the social media ecosystem—from account setup and branding to content creation, automation, engagement, lead routing, analytics, and continuous optimization.

title: Junior/Senior OSINT Analyst
description:
Sentinel Investigations is a licensed Australian investigations firm. We run investigations for corporate, legal and insurance clients using our own case management platform, SentinelOps. We are building a remote analyst team in the Philippines and are looking for people who want a long-term role in investigations, not a short-term VA job.



You will do open source research on people, companies and assets for active cases. Each task comes with a clear brief. Your Account Manager reviews all of your work before it reaches the client and handles your onboarding, admin, pay and day-to-day support.



What you will do



Research individuals and companies across social media, news, public records, business registries and court listings

Confirm identity by linking accounts, aliases, addresses and associates, and separating real matches from people with the same name

Search for adverse media, business interests, directorships and signs of assets or lifestyle

Capture every finding with screenshots, URLs and timestamps so it can be checked later

Write short, factual findings in SentinelOps, stating how confident you are in each one

Flag anything urgent or outside the brief to your Account Manager straight away



All collection is passive and lawful. You will never contact a subject, use fake identities to engage with anyone, or access private or restricted accounts.



What we need:



At least 2 years in OSINT, fraud investigation, KYC/AML, trust and safety, threat intelligence or investigative research

Excellent written English. Your reports are the product.

Attention to detail and patience.

Comfort handling sensitive and sometimes distressing information with complete discretion

Your own computer, a stable internet connection of at least 25 Mbps, a backup connection, and a quiet private workspace

Willingness to provide two professional references.



Nice to have



Experience with Australian, US or UK public records

Experience with link analysis tools such as Maltego or i2

Languages other than English and Filipino



Hours and pay



Full time, 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday, 6:00am to 3:00pm Manila time (9:00am to 6:00pm Sydney time).



Pay is ₱35,000 to ₱55,000 per month depending on experience, plus 13th month pay. There is a pay review after 6 months and a clear path to Senior Analyst. Room for negotiation for Senior Analysts with a proven track record. 



How to apply



Send your CV and a short cover note (under 200 words) covering:



Your investigation or research experience

One example of something you found online that others missed, and how you found it



Shortlisted applicants will complete a short written test, then an interview with a 3 month probation. We ask that you do not use AI tools to write your application. We want to see how you write.
