title: Growth Marketing Specialist
description:
Growth Marketing Specialist



About eXpand AD

eXpand AD is a growth marketing agency serving B2B businesses across the United States and Canada. We help businesses generate qualified leads, acquire customers, and strengthen their digital presence.





Position Overview

The Growth Marketing Specialist manages content marketing, GoHighLevel (GHL) CRM operations, lead generation, and sales execution for eXpand AD and its clients. The role also includes social media management, reporting, and basic website support.



Key Responsibilities



1. Content Marketing and Social Media

Produce at least 5 complete content packages per week for eXpand AD and its clients.

Develop content concepts and calendars aligned with client briefs, brand guidelines, target audiences, and marketing objectives.

Create copy, graphics, carousels, short-form videos, captions, and calls to action.

Adapt approved content for LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, and other relevant platforms.

Use Canva and AI tools to support content production.

Schedule and publish approved content; monitor reach, engagement, clicks, inquiries, and leads where measurable.

Support WordPress publishing and basic SEO and generative engine optimization (GEO).

Maintain organized content files and publication schedules.

Content package definition: One campaign-ready deliverable containing the relevant concept, copy, creative assets or video, captions, and calls to action as appropriate. Repurposing the same package across platforms does not count as an additional package. Five packages is the weekly minimum, not a maximum.



2. GoHighLevel CRM and Automation

Maintain accurate contacts, lead sources, pipeline stages, tasks, and follow-up dates.

Manage opportunities from initial lead entry through closed-won or closed-lost status.

Configure and maintain approved workflows, calendars,
 sequences, and basic automations.

Investigate failed actions, duplicate messages, and missed follow-ups.

Ensure active opportunities have a documented status and next step.

Update CRM records within one business day of relevant activity.

Improve pipeline visibility, automation reliability, and follow-up processes.

Support approved client CRM tasks within the assigned scope.



3. Sales and Customer Acquisition

Research businesses and decision-makers in the United States and Canada.

Build targeted prospect lists and conduct personalized outbound outreach through approved channels.

Qualify prospects based on business fit, need, authority, timing, and budget where ascertainable.

Manage follow-ups, book discovery meetings, handle objections, prepare approved proposals, and close deals within delegated authority.

Track sales activity, proposals, opportunity outcomes, customer acquisition, and revenue through GoHighLevel.

Analyze lost opportunities and recommend improvements to outreach and conversion.



Monthly sales target: 10 new paying customers.

A completed deal means a new customer purchasing an approved eXpand AD service, recorded in GoHighLevel and verified under the company's sales process. Leads, meetings, and proposals alone do not count. Performance will be assessed in context of lead availability and quality, offer competitiveness, sales-cycle length, resources, and timely commercial approvals.



4. Reporting and Coordination

Submit one consolidated weekly report covering content output, measurable performance, CRM activity, qualified leads, meetings, pipeline progression, closed deals, revenue where available, blockers, and next steps.

Maintain accurate records and communicate issues promptly.

Follow approved client communication and campaign procedures.

Obtain approval before committing to pricing, proposals, discounts, campaigns, or other external commercial commitments.

Flag capacity constraints and deadline risks promptly.



Work Prioritization

The role is limited to 20 hours per week. Unless otherwise directed, priorities are:

Scheduled content deliverables and urgent client commitments.

Active sales opportunities, follow-ups, and meetings.

CRM accuracy, pipeline maintenance, and automation reliability.

Website support and other improvements.

The specialist must communicate competing deadlines and capacity constraints promptly.



First 14 Days

The initial 14 days focus on onboarding, understanding company services and target customers, learning brand standards, verifying system access, and establishing an actionable sales pipeline.



Expected activities:

Complete onboarding and review services, target audiences, and sales materials.

Review existing marketing assets, calendars, brand guidelines, and client requirements.

Verify access to GoHighLevel, WordPress, Canva, AI tools, and other required systems.

Establish a content production and publishing schedule.

Begin producing at least 5 complete content packages per week.

Review the sales pipeline, identify follow-up opportunities, and begin prospecting.

Verify CRM data quality and identify workflow issues.

Submit weekly progress reports.

The manager will review progress at day 14 and agree on subsequent priorities. Initial performance will account for onboarding, access, lead availability, approval turnaround, and sales-cycle length. The ongoing target of 10 new paying customers per month remains the commercial objective.



Required Qualifications

At least 2 years of marketing, growth, or related experience.

At least 2 years of direct sales experience, including prospecting, qualification, follow-up, and closing.

Practical GoHighLevel CRM and sales-pipeline experience.

Professional English suitable for client calls with US and Canadian businesses.

Working knowledge of Canva, WordPress, and AI productivity or content tools.

Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook, or equivalent applications.

Ability to create content for multiple platforms and follow brand guidelines.

Strong communication, organization, and independent execution skills.

Evidence of personal contribution to previously closed sales deals.

Ability to meet the agreed schedule independently.



Languages

English: Professional fluency in written and spoken English.

Additional languages: French, Spanish, Arabic, and German are advantageous. Applicants should specify their proficiency levels.



Working Terms

Location: Remote; international applicants welcome.

Contract: Part-time freelance.

Rate: US$4/hour, up to 20 hours per week.

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 11:00 AM–3:00 PM US Eastern Time. Applicants must verify local working hours.

Payment: Monthly in USD for approved hours worked. Payment method, invoicing, approval process, and payment date will be specified in the freelance agreement.

Additional hours: Require prior approval.

Tools and expenses: Required company accounts and resources will be specified. No subscriptions or expenses may be incurred on behalf of the company without prior written approval.

Future opportunity: Full-time work may be considered based on performance, business needs, and budget; it is not guaranteed.



Application Requirements



Applicants must submit:

Resume or professional profile.

Short introduction describing relevant experience.

Examples of personally closed deals, including role, approximate value, and contribution.

Evidence of practical GoHighLevel experience.

Relevant marketing portfolio or work samples.

Earliest available start date.

Confirmation of acceptance of the hourly rate and schedule.

Languages spoken and proficiency levels.

Redact confidential client information. Do not submit passwords or private customer data.



Selection Process

Shortlisted candidates will participate in a structured interview covering content production, GoHighLevel, sales experience, English communication, office-suite proficiency, additional languages where relevant, availability, and evidence of previous work and personally closed deals.



Performance Management



Performance will be reviewed through regular check-ins and a weekly scorecard covering:

Content packages completed and approved.

Delivery timeliness and quality.

CRM accuracy and follow-up completion.

Prospecting and qualified opportunities.

Meetings, proposals, closed customers, and revenue where available.

Automation reliability, reporting, communication, ownership, and blocker resolution.

Targets and priorities may be reviewed as business conditions and available resources change. Material changes to working hours, compensation, or contractual obligations must be agreed through the contract process.



Confidentiality, Data Security, and Compliance

Protect company, client, prospect, and customer information. Use authorized accounts and tools, follow applicable laws and platform policies, and never disclose confidential information to unauthorized parties or upload it to unapproved AI services. Use approved claims and commercial terms only. Report suspected data incidents promptly.

Work-product ownership, confidentiality, account access, and return or deletion of company information will be governed by the freelance agreement and applicable law.



Core Competencies

Content creation; CRM and automation; sales and lead generation; B2B digital marketing; SEO/GEO; Canva, WordPress, and AI tools; Microsoft Office; analytics and reporting; communication; organization; confidentiality; and independent execution.



eXpand AD welcomes applicants of all backgrounds.

* Export orders daily from the Shopify ParcelPanel app

* Update and maintain our shipping/tracking sheet accurately

* Check parcel tracking through 17Track, YunExpress, ParcelsApp, and other relevant tracking platforms

* Review the latest tracking information and identify orders that require action

* Take the correct action based on each parcel status, including:

  * In Transit

  * Pick Up

  * RTS / Return to Sender

  * Info Received

  * OOS / Out of Stock

  * Lost In Transit

  * Delivered

  * Failed Delivery

  * Other shipping exceptions



Who We’re Looking For



*Extremely accurate and detail-oriented — small mistakes can have big consequences

* Reliable and consistent with daily recurring tasks

* Able to work independently and stay focused on repetitive tracking work

* Strong written English for customer communication when required

* Comfortable following SOPs and taking the correct action based on each situation

* Organized and confident working with spreadsheets

* Able to identify inconsistencies or unusual tracking activity

* Responsible and willing to take ownership of assigned tasks

* Comfortable communicating with the team when clarification or escalation is needed

* Previous experience with e-commerce, order tracking, logistics, or customer support is a plus

* Familiarity with Shopify, ParcelPanel, 17Track, YunExpress, ParcelsApp, Gorgias, Google Sheets, and Slack is an advantage



What We Offer



* Clear SOPs, trackers, and training, so you know exactly what’s expected

* A direct and supportive team where your input matters

* Steady, recurring work with room to grow

* Direct collaboration with the CS Manager and a small, driven team



How to Apply



Send us:



1. Your CV, or a short overview of your previous e-commerce, logistics, order tracking, or customer support experience

2. A list of the tools you’ve worked with — for example Shopify, ParcelPanel, Gorgias, 17Track, Google Sheets, etc. — and how long you’ve used each

3. A short video (1–2 minutes) introducing yourself and telling us why you’re a great fit for this role.



*Applications without a video will not be considered.*



⚠️ Important: Start your video by saying the words “DB Duo.”



This tells us you’ve read the full job post and can follow instructions carefully.



We’re looking for someone who is precise, dependable, organized, and committed to getting the details right. If you’re someone who notices the small things and makes sure nothing falls through the cracks, we’d love to hear from you!

title: AI Automation Developer (Python, n8n, API Integrations, claude code)
description:
WHO WE ARE

Nexus Digital is a digital transformation partner based in Melbourne, Australia, started by two brothers, Ryan and Cooper Lanyon. We help established businesses grow and maximise the productivity of their teams, without needing extra headcount, by building AI systems into their processes and workflows. We build everything with Claude Code, and we want someone who works the same way.



WHAT WE DO

- Workshops: hands-on AI workshops where business owners build working tools with us in the room

- In-person training: teaching teams to use and run AI in their day-to-day work

- Full custom builds: AI systems built into a company's operations. Assistants connected to their
, CRM, project tools and data, live dashboards, daily briefings, and automations that take hours of manual work off a team every week

- Ongoing support: we maintain and extend everything we build, so it keeps getting better month after month



We don't build demos or chatbots. Our systems run in production on servers we set up and secure ourselves, with approval steps on anything risky, and the client owns everything we build.



WHO WE WORK WITH

Established Australian businesses, typically 10 to 50 staff, in industries like transport and logistics, health, media and professional services, plus business owners who come through our workshops.



WHAT'S HAPPENING RIGHT NOW

- We just ran our first AI workshop with 16 business owners in the room, and it has already turned into partnerships

- We've partnered with a Melbourne brand agency whose clients' products sit on the shelves of Australia's biggest supermarkets. We're the AI team behind their campaigns

- We've partnered with an NDIS provider (Australia's disability support sector), and together we're launching our first software product, built to roll out to providers right across the country in a sector worth nearly $50 billion a year

- There's a pipeline of businesses lined up behind that, waiting for us to build for them



WHERE WE'RE HEADED

We're on a mission to help 1,000 Australian businesses implement and adopt AI, then train their teams to run it. We're growing faster than the two of us can build. Over the next few years we want Nexus Digital to be the name Australian businesses think of when they want AI that actually works in their operations, with our own products, a big client book and a full team of engineers delivering it. You would be the first engineer on that team, getting in on the ground floor. As it grows, the person in this seat is the one we want leading builds, setting the standards, and helping us hire the people who come next.



WHY THIS ROLE IS WORTH IT

- You work directly with the two founders, not through layers of management

- Real client and product work from your first few weeks, not tickets on a backlog nobody reads

- The newest tooling every day: Claude Code, MCP servers, AI agents running in production

- A long-term, full-time role, with a pay review at 90 days and a bonus on every project delivered clean

- Room to grow into a lead role as the team grows



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Turn manual business processes into automations that run every day

- Connect CRMs,
, calendars and project tools through their APIs and webhooks

- Move workflows from no-code tools into Python when they outgrow them

- Write tests and clear docs so non-technical people can use what you build

- Over time, own client builds end to end



YOU'VE DONE

- Claude Code as your daily tool: you plan the work, steer it, and review everything it writes before it ships

- Automations a real business relies on, in n8n, Make or Zapier, and in code

- Python scripts or services against REST APIs

- An LLM API (Claude or OpenAI) used inside a workflow

- Clear written and spoken English



NICE TO HAVE

MCP servers, Supabase, Linux servers



HOW WE WORK

- Systems over experiments. If it doesn't run reliably every day, it isn't finished.

- Security is part of the job. Our clients trust us with their business data, and we treat it that way.

- Clear over clever. Everything we build should make sense to the person who uses it.

- Honest over hype. If something won't work, we say so before we build it.

- A quick daily check-in with us on Slack, fast answers when you're stuck, and real ownership of your work.



TERMS

Full-time, 40 hours a week, 10am to 6pm Melbourne time (7am to 3pm Manila). USD 1,200 a month to start (negotiable)  depending on experience, reviewed at 90 days, plus a bonus on every project delivered clean.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your application with the word AUTOMATE.

2. In two or three lines, tell us how you use Claude Code day to day.

3. After you apply, we'll message you a short intro video from our co-founder and ask for a 2 to 3 minute video back. We only move forward with people who send one.

title: Home Health Intake Coordinator
description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented and compassionate Medical Intake Coordinator to manage patient intake processes for our Home Health service in California. This role serves as the primary point of contact for new referrals, patients, families, and referral partners, while also supporting light marketing and relationship-building efforts with existing referral sources.



Key Responsibilities:

1. Receive and process new hospice and home health referrals via phone, fax, email, and EMR systems.

2. Verify patient demographics, insurance eligibility, and medical documentation in compliance with HIPAA, Medicare, and California state regulations.

3. Coordinate and schedule initial assessments, admissions, and start-of-care visits with clinical staff.

4. Communicate clearly and compassionately with patients, families, physicians, hospitals, and referral partners.

5. Maintain accurate, complete, and confidential patient records in accordance with HIPAA privacy and security standards.

6. Track referral status, follow-ups, and outcomes to ensure timely admission or appropriate disposition.

7. Collaborate with clinical, billing, and administrative teams to ensure smooth transitions from intake to care delivery.

8. Provide updates to existing referral sources regarding patient status and admission outcomes.

9. Support minimal marketing activities such as maintaining referral lists, sending updates or materials to existing referral partners, and assisting with referral relationship management.

10. Assist with intake and referral reports as needed.



Requirements:

Previous experience in medical intake, hospice, home health, or healthcare coordination preferred.

Working knowledge of HIPAA compliance, patient confidentiality, and proper handling of PHI.

title: Marketing Operations & Social Media Manager
description:
Department: Marketing

Work Type: Remote



Role Overview

We are looking for a detail-oriented and organized Marketing Operations & Social Media Manager to oversee the day-to-day operations of our creators' social media accounts.

This role focuses on ensuring content is organized, scheduled, published consistently, and tracked accurately. You will coordinate with editors and the marketing team, maintain content calendars and trackers, monitor account health, and prepare performance reports.

The ideal candidate is proactive, reliable, comfortable managing multiple accounts, and able to identify operational issues before they affect the team's workflow.



Key Responsibilities

- Social Media Management & Publishing

- Manage assigned social media accounts and maintain consistent posting schedules.

- Maintain content calendars and schedule posts through Vista Social.

- Check scheduled posts for gaps, failed uploads, and drafts awaiting publication.

- Manage post queues, recurring slots, and posting schedules across profiles.

- Use recommended posting times and follow each account's assigned strategy.

- Submit content for approval, follow up on pending reviews, and ensure only approved content is published.

- Monitor account connections and troubleshoot publishing issues.



Content Organization & Google Drive Management

- Track available content and identify gaps in the content pipeline.

- Keep editing trackers and content statuses updated.



Metrics & Performance Reporting

-Track reach, impressions, engagement, followers, profile visits, post counts, and new subscribers.

-Verify data accuracy and maintain reporting spreadsheets.



Account Maintenance & Technical Operations

-Monitor social media account connections and publishing access on Vista Social

-Monitor account status in GeeLark virtual phones and follow approved account-maintenance and warm-up procedures.

-Escalate account restrictions, disconnections, and technical issues to the appropriate team member.



Team Administration & Coordination

-Maintain task trackers, deadlines, approval statuses, and operational documentation.

-Assign tasks and reviewers according to brand and team responsibilities.

-Maintain brand-specific posting schedules, time zones, and account access permissions.

-Coordinate with editors, marketing team members, and other relevant stakeholders to keep deliverables on track.

- Provide daily updates on completed work, pending tasks, blockers, and issues.

- Follow up proactively on overdue tasks and unresolved operational issues.



Daily Responsibilities

- Check scheduled posts, publishing queues, and account connections.

- Identify posting gaps, failed uploads, and content awaiting approval.

- Update content calendars and task trackers.

- Follow up on pending edits, revisions, and deliverables.

- Coordinate with the team on urgent issues and deadlines.

- Send a daily update covering completed work, pending items, and blockers.



Weekly Responsibilities

- Every Tuesday: Update creator metrics using Vista Social and Inflow.

- Review posting consistency

- Audit upcoming schedules and identify content gaps.

- Follow up on outstanding edits and approvals.

- Review account health and flag technical issues.

- Ensure content calendars and libraries are ready for the upcoming week.



Required Skills & Qualifications

- Experience managing multiple social media accounts.

- Familiarity with social media scheduling and analytics tools, preferably Vista Social.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Experience maintaining content calendars, trackers, and Google Drive folders.

- Ability to coordinate with editors and follow up on deadlines.

- Basic understanding of social media metrics and performance reporting.

- Strong written communication and documentation skills.

- Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and flag issues proactively.

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote team environment.



Key Performance Expectations

- Social media posts are scheduled and published consistently according to approved calendars.

- Content calendars, libraries, and trackers remain accurate and up to date.

- Editing tasks and approvals are followed up on promptly.

- Weekly metrics are submitted accurately and on time.

- Account issues and publishing failures are identified and escalated promptly.

- Daily updates clearly communicate progress, pending tasks, and blockers. -

- Operational tasks are completed without requiring constant follow-up from the Creative Director.



What Success Looks Like

The Marketing Operations & Social Media Manager keeps the team's day-to-day execution organized and running smoothly. The Creative Director can focus on strategy, creative direction, and creator growth because publishing, tracking, coordination, and routine operational

follow-ups are being handled reliably.

title: News Writing Assistant
description:
News Writing Assistant



Remote | Philippines | Paid trial



Pay: $600 a month



Hours: Monday to Friday, 7am to 3pm UK time (3pm to 11pm Philippine time).



Start: early to mid-November 2026



About us



We’re a UK news agency. We supply stories, photos and video to major news websites.



We need a careful writer for one task: turning a story our editors have chosen into a short news draft, using our template and AI tools.



For every story:



What we give you



1. The story, chosen by our news team

2. The source links, pictures and video

3. Our template, style guide and example stories

4. The AI and translation tools you need



What you do



1. Read everything in the package. Translate it with our tools where needed.

2. Write a short article draft in our template, with help from AI.

3. Check the draft against our accuracy checklist:

   1. Every name, date, place, number and quote matches the sources.

   2. The headline and story should only describe what the pictures or video actually show.

   3. For live stories, such as disasters or accidents, a quick search shows if numbers like the death toll have changed. Update the number and add a link to the new source so the editor can verify it.

4. Send the draft to the editor and list anything you’re unsure about.

5. An editor reviews every draft before it goes out and will ask questions if they arise.



Important: If sources disagree or something can’t be checked, never guess. Always flag it to an editor.



The day



1. 7 to 11am UK is the busiest time. Deadlines are tight and articles need to be written and checked quickly.

2. After 11am, you’ll help the team and learn new tasks.

3. Once you’re fully trained, the aim is to write five drafts a day.



What we’re looking for



1. Excellent written English

2. Careful reading. You notice when something doesn’t add up.

3. You ask when you’re not sure.

4. Quick, reliable replies on Slack



You don’t need to be a journalist. Writing, editing or research experience helps. You’ll show us your skills in the paid assessment.



You’ll need



1. Your own laptop

2. A reliable internet connection



If a storm, power cut or connection problem stops you working, tell your editor as soon as you can.



Sensitive material



Stories often involve crime, violence, accidents and deaths. Some pictures and video may be distressing. Only apply if you’re comfortable with this.



How to apply



1. Subject line: News Writing Assistant – [Your Full Name]

2. In around 150 words, in your own words, tell us:

   1. Your writing, editing or research experience

   2. Whether you can work 7am to 3pm UK time, Monday to Friday, and when you could start

   3. One thing you’d check before trusting a news story written by AI

3. If you have one, include an example of your writing or research. Say what you did, and whether you used AI.

4. You must end your application with the phrase “Checked and ready to file”.



What happens next



1. Paid assessment: shortlisted applicants get an AI-written article draft to check and correct against the sources. We’ll confirm the fee and time allowed before you start.

2. Paid pilot: successful applicants may be offered a limited paid pilot.

3. Regular work: if the pilot goes well for both sides, we’ll agree ongoing work.



We’ll assess:



- Your accuracy against the sources

- Your written English and use of the template and AI tool

- Whether you flag what’s unclear

- Your speed

- How much editing your draft needs

title: Customer Operations Dispatcher
description:
Dropcurb is a growing U.S. junk-removal marketplace. We are hiring a dispatcher to help coordinate customers, pickup providers, quotes, and active orders.



This is a fast-moving role, but being fast is not enough. We are looking for someone who is careful, responsible, customer-focused, and willing to verify information before making decisions.



Our biggest requirement is simple: do not guess.



If something does not look right, stop, check the information, ask questions, or escalate it.

Customer Operations Dispatcher



Remote - Philippines

Full-Time

U.S. Hours



Responsibilities:



Respond to customers and pickup providers



Handle and prioritize incoming quotes



Monitor active and upcoming orders



Review order details, photos, messages, and completion proof

Request additional photos or information when something is unclear



Help resolve active pickup issues



Keep customers updated when there is a problem



Escalate unusual, high-risk, or unclear situations



Follow company procedures carefully



Maintain accurate notes and order information



Provide professional, natural English communication to U.S. customers



Customer experience is extremely important to us.



If Dropcurb makes a mistake, we do not blame the customer, the pickup provider, or another employee. We take ownership, apologize when appropriate, explain what we are doing to fix it, and make sure the customer is taken care of.



We are looking for someone who:



Has excellent written and spoken English



Pays close attention to detail



Cares about customers



Can work quickly without becoming careless



Is comfortable asking questions when unsure



Takes responsibility for mistakes



Does not become defensive when receiving feedback



Can prioritize several urgent tasks at once



Has good common sense and judgment



Can stay calm during busy periods



Learns from mistakes and does not repeat them



Is reliable and consistent



You are not a good fit if:



You regularly guess when information is unclear



You rush through important decisions



You blame other people when something goes wrong



You are careless with customer issues or money



You become defensive when corrected



You repeatedly make the same mistakes



You need constant supervision



You care more about closing a task than making sure it was handled correctly



Schedule:



Approximately 9 PM to 7 AM Philippines time, 6 days per week.



Exact schedule may vary depending on team coverage.

Your relevant work experience



Your current or most recent monthly compensation



Your expected monthly compensation



Your availability and earliest start date

A customer messages:

Write the exact response you would send to the customer.

title: Senior GoHighLevel Funnel & Marketing Automation Expert (Full Time)
description:
ABOUT US

The Nonprofit Guy helps nonprofit founders and executives start, fund, and grow their organizations through coaching, done-for-you services, and an online academy. We run weekly webinars, major virtual events, memberships, and high-ticket offers, and GoHighLevel is the engine behind all of it. We need a true GHL expert to own our system, raise our event show rates, and partner with our media buyer to drive growth.



This is a fast-paced role. Priorities shift, launches overlap, and deadlines are real. If you thrive on speed and still never drop a detail, this is for you.



SCHEDULE

Full time, 40 hours per week. Must overlap at least 4 hours with US Eastern Time.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Funnel Design

- Design high-converting, modern, mobile-first funnels: webinar registration, sales pages, opt-ins, application funnels, and thank-you pages

- Build from scratch, not just templates, with a strong eye for layout, typography, spacing, and brand consistency

- A/B test pages and improve conversion rates



Weekly Webinars and Major Events

- Update our weekly webinar funnel every week: new dates, titles, speakers, and reminder sequences

- Build and launch funnels for major events and summits: registration, ticketing, VIP upsells, reminders, and post-event follow-up

- Meet hard deadlines. Event funnels must be live, tested, and tracking correctly before ads go on



Show Rate Optimization

- Own and improve show rates for weekly webinars and virtual events

- Build multi-touch reminder sequences across
, SMS, and voi
 drops (confirmation, 24 hours, 1 hour, 15 minutes, and "we're live now")

- Add calendar invites, add-to-calendar links, and value-driven reminders

- Track registrant-to-attendee rates weekly and test new tactics to raise them



Meta Ads Collaboration

- Work directly with our media buyer to launch and support Meta ad campaigns

- Build ad-specific landing pages that match funnel messaging to the ad creative

- Set up and verify Meta Pixel and Conversions API tracking inside GHL funnels

- Set up UTM tracking and attribution so we know which ads drive registrations and sales

- Sync GHL lists for retargeting and lookalike audiences

- Share weekly funnel data (opt-in rate, show rate, cost per registrant) with the media buyer



Automations and Workflows

- Build and maintain complex workflows: lead nurture, webinar reminders and no-show follow-up, onboarding, payment and failed-payment flows, and re-engagement

- Use if/else branching, wait steps, goal events, triggers, webhooks, and custom values

- Troubleshoot broken automations independently



Zapier and Integrations

- Build and maintain Zapier automations connecting GHL to our other tools (webinar platforms, payment processors, Google Sheets, Slack, and more)

- Troubleshoot failed Zaps and broken integrations quickly



Payment Processors

- Connect and manage multiple payment processors in GHL (Stripe, NMI, Authorize.net, PayPal, and others)

- Set up order forms, payment plans, upsells, and order bumps

- Build failed-payment recovery workflows and make sure every purchase triggers the right access and onboarding



GHL AI Features

- Set up and train Conversation AI for chat and SMS support

- Configure Voice AI and AI agents where useful

- Use Content AI and Workflow AI to speed up builds and copy



Contact List Management

- Manage a large and growing contact database: smart lists, tagging strategy, custom fields, and segmentation

- Clean data: dedupe, merge, fix imports, and remove bounces and invalid numbers

- Run bulk actions and imports without breaking workflows




 and SMS Sequences

- Write and build
 and SMS sequences for launches, webinars, events, nurtures, and win-backs

- Manage deliverability: SPF, DKIM, DMARC, dedicated sending domains, warm-up, and list hygiene

- Keep SMS compliant with A2P 10DLC and opt-out rules

- Track opens, clicks, replies, and conversions and report weekly



Customer Support

- Respond to members and clients through GHL conversations (chat, SMS, and
)

- Fix access and payment issues and escalate when needed



REQUIREMENTS

- 3+ years of hands-on GoHighLevel experience at expert level

- A design portfolio of funnels YOU built, with live links

- Proven track record of increasing webinar or event show rates (share your numbers)

- Proven experience managing large contact lists (10,000+ contacts)

- Hands-on experience with GHL AI features (Conversation AI at minimum)

- Strong understanding of
 deliverability and A2P 10DLC

- Experience working alongside a media buyer or ads team

- Hands-on experience with Meta Pixel, Conversions API, and UTM tracking in GHL

- Experience running recurring webinars and live or virtual events in GHL

- Hands-on Zapier experience, including multi-step Zaps and troubleshooting

- Experience connecting and managing multiple payment processors in GHL

- Thrives in a fast-paced environment: handles shifting priorities, quick turnarounds, and multiple launches at once

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Reliable internet and a quiet workspace



BONUS

- Copywriting skills

- Canva or Figma

- Experience with coaching, education, or membership businesses



HIRING PROCESS

Application review, then a paid skills test, then a live interview, then a paid trial period.



HOW TO APPLY

Do NOT apply if you cannot show live funnel links you designed. Send:

1. 3 live funnel links you designed and built

2. A Loom video (under 5 minutes) walking through your most complex workflow

3. Answers to the screening questions below

4. Start your subject line with "Nonprofit Guy Senior GHL"



SCREENING QUESTIONS

1. How would you set up Conversation AI to handle member support questions without giving wrong answers?

2. You import 15,000 contacts and half are duplicates or have bad
s. How do you clean the list before any campaign goes out?

3. Our
 open rates dropped from 35% to 12%. What do you check, in order?

4. How would you build a webinar sequence, from registration through replay and offer, across
 and SMS?

5. Our media buyer says ads are getting clicks but registrations are low. What do you check on the funnel and tracking side?

6. Walk me through your weekly checklist for updating a recurring webinar funnel so nothing breaks.

7. Our webinar show rate is 22%. Walk me through what you'd change to get it above 40%.

8. A customer pays through our payment processor but never gets course access. How do you find where it broke across GHL and Zapier?

9. It's Monday. You have a webinar funnel to update, an event launching Thursday, and a broken payment workflow. How do you prioritize your day?

title: Full-Stack Developer, AI Products (Next.js, Python, Supabase)
description:
WHO WE ARE

Nexus Digital is a digital transformation partner based in Melbourne, Australia, started by two brothers, Ryan and Cooper Lanyon. We help established businesses grow and maximise the productivity of their teams, without needing extra headcount, by building AI systems into their processes and workflows. We build everything with Claude Code, and we want someone who works the same way.



WHAT WE DO

- Workshops: hands-on AI workshops where business owners build working tools with us in the room

- In-person training: teaching teams to use and run AI in their day-to-day work

- Full custom builds: AI systems built into a company's operations. Assistants connected to their
, CRM, project tools and data, live dashboards, daily briefings, and automations that take hours of manual work off a team every week

- Ongoing support: we maintain and extend everything we build, so it keeps getting better month after month



We don't build demos or chatbots. Our systems run in production on servers we set up and secure ourselves, with approval steps on anything risky, and the client owns everything we build.



WHO WE WORK WITH

Established Australian businesses, typically 10 to 50 staff, in industries like transport and logistics, health, media and professional services, plus business owners who come through our workshops.



WHAT'S HAPPENING RIGHT NOW

- We just ran our first AI workshop with 16 business owners in the room, and it has already turned into partnerships

- We've partnered with a Melbourne brand agency whose clients' products sit on the shelves of Australia's biggest supermarkets. We're the AI team behind their campaigns

- We've partnered with an NDIS provider (Australia's disability support sector), and together we're launching our first software product, built to roll out to providers right across the country in a sector worth nearly $50 billion a year

- There's a pipeline of businesses lined up behind that, waiting for us to build for them



WHERE WE'RE HEADED

We're on a mission to help 1,000 Australian businesses implement and adopt AI, then train their teams to run it. We're growing faster than the two of us can build. Over the next few years we want Nexus Digital to be the name Australian businesses think of when they want AI that actually works in their operations, with our own products, a big client book and a full team of engineers delivering it. You would be the first engineer on that team, getting in on the ground floor. As it grows, the person in this seat is the one we want leading builds, setting the standards, and helping us hire the people who come next.



WHY THIS ROLE IS WORTH IT

- You work directly with the two founders, not through layers of management

- Real client and product work from your first few weeks, not tickets on a backlog nobody reads

- The newest tooling every day: Claude Code, MCP servers, AI agents running in production

- A long-term, full-time role, with a pay review at 90 days and a bonus on every project delivered clean

- Room to grow into a lead role as the team grows



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build dashboards and websites in Next.js, deployed on Vercel

- Build the Python services and AI features behind them

- Connect business tools through their APIs

- Write tests and clear docs so non-technical people can use what you build

- Over time, own client builds end to end



YOU'VE DONE

- Claude Code as your daily tool: you plan the work, steer it, and review everything it writes before it ships

- Next.js or React apps that real users use

- Python or Node backends with Postgres or Supabase

- At least one feature built on an LLM API (Claude or OpenAI)

- Clear written and spoken English



NICE TO HAVE

MCP servers, Linux servers, n8n



HOW WE WORK

- Systems over experiments. If it doesn't run reliably every day, it isn't finished.

- Security is part of the job. Our clients trust us with their business data, and we treat it that way.

- Clear over clever. Everything we build should make sense to the person who uses it.

- Honest over hype. If something won't work, we say so before we build it.

- A quick daily check-in with us on Slack, fast answers when you're stuck, and real ownership of your work.



TERMS

Full-time, 40 hours a week, 10am to 6pm Melbourne time (7am to 3pm Manila). USD 1,300 a month to start (negotiable) depending on experience, reviewed at 90 days, plus a bonus on every project delivered clean.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your application with the word FULLSTACK.

2. In two or three lines, tell us how you use Claude Code day to day.

3. After you apply, we'll message you a short intro video from our co-founder and ask for a 2 to 3 minute video back. We only move forward with people who send one.

This is a great opportunity to do meaningful work with a professional team, develop your knowledge of Australian legal matters and take real responsibility for keeping client files moving.



The role

You will manage a portfolio of up to 90 files. At any time, you should be able to explain exactly where each matter stands, what is outstanding, who needs to be followed up and what happens next.

Your responsibilities will include:

- Managing files from initial information gathering through preparation for submission and ongoing claim follow-up

- Requesting, organising and checking medical reports, doctors’ certificates, employment and income records, Centrelink information and client authorities

- Following up with clients, medical providers and other relevant parties by phone and

- Maintaining accurate file notes, documents, deadlines, task lists and CRM records

- Preparing claim documentation and draft submissions for review by the supervising lawyer

- Identifying missing information, delays and approaching deadlines, and raising issues promptly

You will work closely with our lawyers, who provide legal oversight and final review. This role is about taking ownership of the preparation, organisation and day-to-day progress of your files.

You can expect support from an assistant as part of the file-management arrangements. You will help coordinate that support while remaining responsible for knowing what is happening across your portfolio.

Client communication is part of the role. There is no cold calling or sales prospecting.

What we’re looking for

- Relevant experience in legal administration, file management or a paralegal role

- Exceptional attention to detail and strong organisational skills

- A full professional command of written and spoken English, including excellent grammar and clear, confident client communication

- The ability to stay on top of a substantial file load without losing sight of individual clients or outstanding tasks

Legal studies or a law degree would be an advantage, but are not essential. Extensive Australian legal experience is not required; relevant experience, accuracy and the ability to learn are what matter.

EXCEPTIONAL WRITTEN AND SPOKEN ENGLISH, ATTENTION TO DETAIL AND RELIABLE FILE MANAGEMENT ARE NON-NEGOTIABLE.



Working arrangements

This is a full-time position. You must be available and focused on this role from 9:00 am to 5:00 pm Sydney time, Monday to Friday. Your local working hours will change when Sydney enters or leaves daylight saving time.

You will work remotely from home, with access to business-provided Slack, Google Workspace, CRM and file-management software.

title: Reddit Account Operations | $5 per Accepted Account + Post Commission
description:
We are hiring an experienced Reddit account preparation and maintenance specialist. We provide the accounts, authorized systems/tools, target subreddits and category-specific written requirements. You do not need to buy accounts, proxies or software. This is not an account buying/selling role.



PAYMENT — PLEASE READ FIRST

- USD 5 per completed account that meets the agreed requirements and passes acceptance. This is outcome-based work, not an hourly position.

- After account delivery, ongoing approved posting assignments earn a separate commission per successfully published and accepted post. The per-post rate is discussed privately and confirmed before work starts.

- If an account is banned during preparation or before acceptance, no account-preparation fee is payable, including time spent. You do not reimburse us, pay a penalty or provide a free replacement. Report the issue promptly and stop work on that account pending instructions.



ACCOUNT PREPARATION AND ACCEPTANCE

- Assignments normally use a 7–10 day preparation window. Before each batch, we agree on the starting account status, target subreddits, required outcome, deadline and acceptance evidence.

- Each account has a specified delivery level: comment-ready OR post-ready in the assigned subreddits. Commenting eligibility does not satisfy a post-ready brief. Different categories have different requirements; there is no universal karma or account-age target.

- Participation must be genuine, relevant and permitted by current community rules. Flag any conflict between a brief, community restriction and deadline before starting; do not bypass restrictions.

- Provide concise activity logs and public-visible links/screenshots proving the agreed result. A submission button or content visible only to its author is not enough. The account must be accessible, not banned and meet the brief at acceptance.



ONGOING MAINTENANCE AND POSTING

Continued maintenance and approved posting are part of this role, not just a one-off handover. Follow the assigned plan, check current subreddit rules, report restrictions/removals and keep accurate records. Prepare approved posts, make agreed copy revisions and publish only as authorized.



Before each posting batch, we agree on maintenance duties, content, acceptance checks and verification period, commission, and included revision/reposting limits. Routine maintenance within that batch is covered by its per-post arrangement; standalone maintenance or extra scope is agreed separately. There is no unlimited free maintenance or revision obligation.



A commissioned post must match the brief and rules, be publicly visible in the designated subreddit and pass the agreed acceptance check. Failed, filtered/removed or author-only submissions do not qualify. Edits, retries and permitted replacements for the same assigned post earn one commission when accepted, not duplicate fees, unless separately approved. Report removals first; revise or repost only with approval and where permitted. Never switch accounts or repeatedly repost to evade moderator decisions.



EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

- 3+ years of hands-on Reddit experience, including managing 20–30 accounts concurrently and long-term account maintenance. Experience maintaining accounts for 6+ months is especially relevant.

- Practical knowledge of subreddit commenting and posting eligibility, current Reddit policies and how to check rule changes.

- Strong English, reliable communication, honest reporting, organized logs and secure use of company-provided browser environments and authorized access.



No spam, coordinated voting, fabricated customer experiences, fake reviews, unsolicited bulk DMs, automated mass account creation or ban evasion.



HOW TO APPLY

Start with REDDIT-OPS and give short, specific answers:

1. Your years of Reddit experience, maximum accounts personally managed at once, and evidence of long-term results. Include a redacted SOP or activity-log sample you are authorized to share.

2. One subreddit example: explain its commenting versus posting requirements and where you check the latest rules. Briefly outline your approach to a 7–10 day assignment.

3. Your availability and realistic batch capacity. Confirm acceptance of USD 5 per completed, accepted account, the banned-account terms and ongoing per-post commission arrangement.



Do not send passwords, verification codes, customer personal data or confidential client information. Clearly label newly created samples.

title: Reddit Sales & Growth Specialist | $2-$5 per Verified Order
description:
We are looking for a strong, hands-on Reddit sales and growth operator who can turn useful community participation into verifiable customer orders. You should be able to research communities, write persuasive content, run permitted campaigns, handle replies and improve sales conversion — not just generate posts, karma, views or leads.



COMPENSATION — COMMISSION-BASED

- USD 2–5 per verified, attributable customer order generated through your Reddit work. This is not an hourly writing job and has no hourly salary or guaranteed order volume/income.

- The exact rate within this range, eligible products, attribution method, validation process and payout schedule are agreed before each campaign begins.

- We may use approved tracking links, codes or another agreed method. Only genuine completed orders confirmed through that process qualify. Cancelled, refunded, fraudulent or duplicate orders are excluded; the same order cannot be counted twice.



REDDIT ACCOUNTS PROVIDED

We provide Reddit accounts and authorized access. You do not need to bring or buy accounts. You may optionally use compliant accounts you own or are explicitly authorized to operate, subject to advance agreement and community rules. Owning accounts is not required, and the agreed per-order rate does not change based on account source. Do not share personal passwords or credentials in your application.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Find relevant subreddits, buying-intent discussions and customer problems; build a practical Reddit-to-purchase plan.

- Check each community's current posting, commenting, promotional and moderation rules before acting.

- Write, publish and improve useful posts and comments; answer product questions accurately and disclose commercial relationships where required.

- Run authorized subreddit/community operations, discussions, events and marketing activities where permitted. Where relevant, help operate our own subreddit.

- Guide genuinely interested users to the approved product page, website or private community only when appropriate, permitted and consent-based.

- Track activity through to verified orders, test copy and calls to action, report what converted and improve unsuccessful campaigns. Coordinate with our account-operations team.

- Use AI for research or drafting where helpful, but personally check facts, product claims and final copy.



EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

- At least 3 years of practical Reddit marketing, growth or community-operations experience.

- Real Reddit sales results backed by redacted order/attribution evidence you are authorized to share. Engagement or karma screenshots alone are not sufficient.

- Strong English copywriting, audience research, subreddit operations and conversion judgment.

- Reliable records and honest reporting. Clearly distinguish views, clicks, enquiries and leads from completed orders, and confirmed causes from assumptions.



Campaigns may cover AI, e-commerce, SaaS, pets, home and household products, solar energy, lathes/machining and travel. Tell us your strongest categories; you do not need to be an expert in all of them. Flag technical questions for review rather than inventing claims.



All work must follow Reddit and subreddit rules. No spam, unsolicited bulk DMs, coordinated voting, fabricated experiences, fake reviews or ban evasion. A ban on promotional posts does not permit promotion through comments or private messages. Off-platform follow-up must be consensual and permitted.



HOW TO APPLY

Start with REDDIT-SALES and give short, specific answers:

1. Share one or two Reddit sales campaigns: product/category, dates, verified order results, tracking method and your own contribution. Include redacted proof; clearly label any newly created samples.

2. Link two or three posts/comments you personally created or operated. Briefly explain the relevant community rules and one practical campaign approach for a relevant category.

title: Inside Sales Agent
description:
Inside Sales Agent (ISA) - BuildSignals



ABOUT BUILDSIGNALS

BuildSignals is a pay-per-appointment marketing agency for bathroom remodelers. We run Meta ads for remodeling companies, then call, qualify and book every homeowner lead into an in-home appointment on our clients' calendars.



Our clients only pay for appointments that actually sit, so the ISA is the engine of the business. Every lead you call is money our client already spent, and every appointment you set and confirm is how we get paid.



ROLE OVERVIEW

The Inside Sales Agent (ISA) is the voice of our clients to their homeowner leads. You call every inbound lead fast, qualify them, book them into in-home appointments, confirm those appointments so they show, and handle any customer service the lead needs along the way.



You are also a point of contact for our contractor clients: keeping them updated on appointments, passing along homeowner details, and flagging problems early. You own the CRM, so every lead has a clear status, notes and next step. This is a remote, phone-heavy role for someone who likes talking to people and hates leaving a lead untouched.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Speed to lead and outbound calling

- Call every new inbound lead within 5 minutes of it coming in, on behalf of the client's brand. This applies to every lead from 8am to 8pm in the lead's local time zone, Pacific through Eastern. Anything slower is not accepted.

- Follow the lead follow-up cadence (calls, texts, voi
s) until the lead is booked, disqualified or marked dead

- Work aged and no-show leads through reactivation calls and texts



Qualifying and booking appointments

- Qualify every homeowner on ownership, project type, budget, timeline and decision-makers

- Book qualified homeowners into the client's calendar for an in-home estimate, matching each client's service area and availability

- Make sure every decision-maker (both spouses, co-owners) will be at the appointment. No one-legged appointments.

- Set clear expectations with the homeowner on what happens at the appointment and how long it takes



Confirmations and show rate

- Confirm every appointment by call and text the day before and the day of

- Reschedule cancellations right away instead of letting them drop

- Keep texts short and personal, like a real person texting, not an automated system



Lead customer service

- Answer homeowner questions about the client's services, process and next steps

- Handle inbound calls and texts from leads, including reschedules, follow-up questions and complaints

- Escalate anything outside your scope (pricing, contracts, job issues) to the client or management quickly and politely



Client communication

- Send clients appointment details before each appointment: homeowner name, address, project, budget and notes from the call

- Get the outcome of every appointment from the client (sat, sold, no-show, rescheduled) and log it

- Flag quality issues, calendar gaps or service area problems to management before they become client complaints

- Keep a professional, reliable tone. Clients should feel like you are part of their team.



CRM organization and management

- Keep every lead in the right pipeline and stage in GoHighLevel, with call notes and a next step

- Log every call, text, booking, confirmation and outcome the same day

- Tag disqualified leads with the reason (renter, no budget, out of area, bad number) so we can improve ad targeting

- Keep calendars, pipelines and contact records clean, with no duplicates or stale leads



Reporting and improvement

- Send a short end-of-day report: leads called, contacted, booked, confirmed, and anything management needs to know

- Share patterns you hear on calls (common objections, lead quality, ad questions) so we can improve ads and scripts

- Follow BuildSignals scripts and SOPs, and suggest improvements based on what works on the phone



WHAT COUNTS AS A SAT APPOINTMENT

Every booking is held to this standard. It must have all four:

1. The person is the homeowner

2. Every decision-maker is present

3. The budget is confirmed and fits the project

4. The appointment is held in the home and actually happens



HOW PERFORMANCE IS MEASURED

- Sat appointments: appointments that meet all four sat criteria

- Show rate: 70%+ of booked appointments actually sit

- Speed to lead: under 5 minutes on every lead, 8am to 8pm local time. No exceptions.

- Contact rate: 60%+ of leads reached by phone

- Booking rate: 30%+ of contacted leads booked

- CRM accuracy: 100% of leads with correct stage, notes and next step, same day

- Client feedback: no unresolved complaints on appointment quality or communication



TOOLS YOU WILL USE

- GoHighLevel (GHL): CRM, pipelines, calendars, calling, texting and automations

- Client portal and funnel dashboard: where clients see their leads and appointments

- Phone and SMS: calling and texting leads under each client's brand

- Google Workspace and Slack or text: internal communication



Experience with GHL is a big plus. We train on everything else.



REQUIREMENTS

- 1+ year in appointment setting, inside sales, call center or customer service

- Comfortable making 100+ calls a day and talking to homeowners all day

- Fluent, clear English on the phone and in writing

- Organized and detail-oriented: you log everything and never lose track of a lead

- Reliable, fast internet, a quiet workspace and a headset

- Available to cover lead hours of 8am to 8pm local time across Pacific to Eastern time zones, including some Saturdays

- Coachable: you follow scripts and SOPs and take feedback well



NICE TO HAVE

- Basic contracting or construction experience, or time in home improvement, remodeling or another home-services industry

- GoHighLevel or similar CRM experience

- Bilingual English and Spanish

- Familiarity with NEPQ or other consultative sales frameworks



SCHEDULE AND PAY

- Location: Remote

- Schedule: Full-time

- Pay: $1,000 per month base, plus a bonus on every appointment you book (OTE
)

- Growth: As BuildSignals adds clients, strong ISAs can grow into lead ISA, team trainer or client success roles



HOW TO APPLY

Every applicant must send a Loom video or voice recording (about 60 seconds) introducing yourself as if you were calling a homeowner about their bathroom remodel request. Applications without a Loom or voice recording will not be considered. We hire on how you sound on the phone.

ABOUT US

Advisor AI Solutions (AAIS) builds AI systems and automation for architecture, engineering and green building firms in Canada and the US. We also run a podcast and content program for the industry. We are a small team based in Alberta, and this role works directly with the founder.



THE ROLE

MUST-HAVES

- Willing to screen-share a live client account you built during the interview (workflows, triggers, pipelines). Hide anything private; we want to see the logic.

- Fluent spoken and written English. You will join client calls.

- Firm daily overlap with Mountain Time (Calgary): online 9 AM to 12 PM MT, Monday to Friday, every week. More overlap is welcome; less is a no.

NICE-TO-HAVES

- AI agents: n8n agents, voice or chat agents running for a real client.

- Outbound prospecting and list building: Sales Navigator, Apollo, Clay.

- Meta ads you set up and ran, with cost per lead.

- Content repurposing and podcast editing (Riverside or similar): clips, captions, show notes.

PAY AND CONTRACT

- Weekly hour cap agreed up front.

- Tell us how many active clients you have now and how many hours a week each takes. We check this against your profile, so please be accurate. Other clients are fine; surprises are not.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply here by following these steps. We read every application that follows them and skip the rest.

1. Start your application with the word SHIPPED.

2. Link or describe 2 paid client builds. For each: the client type, what you built, the tools, and the result it drove (for example leads, booked calls, hours saved).

3. State your exact daily overlap window in Mountain Time.

4. State your monthly rate in USD.

5. State your current active clients and the hours you give each.

6. Answer the screening questions in your own words. Short and specific beats long and polished. We can tell when answers are written by AI or read from a script.



Include a Loom showing a live client GoHighLevel account you built (paid client work only).



HIRING PROCESS

1. Short screen (15 minutes): rate, hours, overlap, client load.

2. Live screen-share interview (30 minutes): you walk us through a live client build and we ask how it works and what broke.

3. Paid trial task (2 to 3 hours, paid pro rata at your agreed monthly rate, no client data).

4. Decision within a week of the trial.



Target start: early November 2026.



SCREENING QUESTIONS (answer these in your application)

1. Describe 2 paid client builds in GoHighLevel, Make, Zapier or n8n that are live today or ran for months. For each: client type, what you built, the contract size in USD, and one measurable result (for example leads, booked calls, hours saved). If you have fewer than 2, say so.

2. Pick one of those builds. What broke after it went live, how did you find out, and exactly what did you change in the workflow to fix it?

3. In the interview you will screen-share a live client account you built. Which account will you show (client type only), and what will we see in it: which workflows, triggers, pipelines or integrations?

4. What are your exact working hours, Monday to Friday, in your time zone and in Mountain Time? Confirm you can be online 9 AM to 12 PM MT every weekday.

title: Part-Time 2D Animator / Video Editor (Paper Cutout Style) – Faceless Finance YouTube Channel
description:
I'm launching The Money Desk, a faceless YouTube channel that explains the economy, housing, debt and the stock market in simple terms. I'm looking for a long-term part-time animator / video editor to create 10-12 minute videos in a specific paper-cutout style. This can grow into a full-time role as the channel grows.



THE STYLE

- Paper cutout animation (similar to the construction-paper look of South Park), using our own original characters

- Everything sits on a lined school-paper background

- Cutouts move in choppy, stop-motion steps (about 12 fps)

- Real charts and article screenshots are "taped" onto the paper, with highlighter, red-marker circles and cutout arrows

- Big numbers are made of "money papier-mache" letters (textures provided)

- Transition: the scene crumples into a ball of money and gets tossed away, revealing the next scene, with a paper-crunch sound effect



A style guide with example frames will be sent to shortlisted applicants.



WHAT I PROVIDE

- Script and finished voiceover for every video

- Logo, intro, money textures, style guide and all brand assets

- The charts and screenshots to use, with sources



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Animate about 4 videos per month (10-12 minutes each) to match the voiceover

- Build and reuse a library of cutout characters and props

- Add music, sound effects and on-screen text

- Deliver a first cut within 5 days, with one round of revisions per video



REQUIREMENTS

- Portfolio with 2D animation, cutout or motion graphics work (links required)

- Adobe After Effects, Premiere Pro or similar

- Good English for reading scripts and notes

- Reliable internet and meeting deadlines

- All artwork must be original. The channel owns all assets and videos.



PAY AND TRIAL

- $450-$600 USD per month depending on skill, paid twice a month

- Shortlisted applicants complete a paid test: a 75-second scene, paid $40



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the words "MONEY DESK" and include:

1. 2-3 links to your animation work

2. The software you use

3. Your expected monthly salary



Applications without portfolio links will not be considered.

title: You Tube Video Editor
description:
Team Rajpal, a Greater Toronto Area real estate team, in Pickering specifically is hiring a freelance video editor to produce at least one long-form YouTube video per week. Each video runs 15 to 30 minutes and is either a house tour, a market update or a community update.

This is a remote, ongoing contract. We want one reliable editor who learns our style and becomes part of our weekly content routine.

Scope of work

You will edit one finished video per week, rotating through three formats.

Format

-House Tour- Walkthrough of a listing

-Market Update- Agent/s on camera in front of a green screen explaining market trends- using supporting information

- Community Update- Tour of the community with specific area updates 



Each week you will also deliver a custom thumbnail and, if requested, one or two short vertical clips cut from the main video for YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels.



Style references

Please study these two channels before applying. We want our videos to match their pacing and polish.

• Market updates: Tom Storey (YouTube). Clear, data-driven talking-head videos. Tight cuts with no dead air, clean charts and stats on screen, and a strong hook in the first 30 seconds.

• House tours: Mark Salerno (Salerno Realty). Smooth, cinematic walkthroughs with steady pacing, colour grading, music that suits the home, and clean text for key features.



Community updates should blend the two: Tom Storey's clarity with Mark Salerno's visual quality.



Responsibilities

Editing

• Cut raw footage into a tight, engaging 15–30 minute video, removing pauses, mistakes and filler.

• Add b-roll, drone footage, music, sound design and colour correction.

• Build on-screen graphics: charts and stats for market updates, and address, price and feature callouts for house tours.

• Add Team Rajpal branding, including logo, intro, outro and contact details.

• Add accurate English captions.



YouTube channel support (when needed)

• Upload videos to our channel with titles, descriptions, tags and chapters.

• Upload thumbnails, add end screens and cards, and organise playlists by format.

• Schedule videos to publish at our set weekly time.

• Keep the channel tidy and consistent, and flag anything that needs our attention.



Requirements

Must have

• Excellent written and spoken English. You must catch errors in captions and on-screen text without being told.

• A portfolio of long-form YouTube videos (15+ minutes), ideally including real estate or talking-head content.

• Experience editing for the Canadian market, or the attention to detail to learn our standards (see below).

• Able to deliver within 24 hours of receiving footage.

• Experience uploading to and managing a YouTube channel, including titles, descriptions, thumbnails, playlists and scheduling.

• Professional editing software, such as Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro or DaVinci Resolve.

• Reliable, responsive communication during Toronto business hours (Eastern Time).



Nice to have/BONUS

• Experience editing real estate content for Canadian agents.

• Motion graphics skills in After Effects or similar.

• YouTube SEO and thumbnail design skills.



Editing for the Canadian market

Our audience is Canadian buyers and sellers, so every video must look and sound Canadian, not American. Use this table as your checklist.



If you are unsure whether something is Canadian, ask before publishing.

Turnaround and weekly workflow

We aim for a first cut within 24 hours of sending footage, and a final version within 24 hours of our feedback.

1. Team Rajpal shares raw footage, notes and any listing or market data through Google Drive.

2. You deliver the first cut and a draft thumbnail within 24 hours.

3. We send one round of consolidated feedback.

4. You deliver the final video, thumbnail and any short clips within 24 hours.

5. If YouTube support is part of your role, you upload and schedule the video.

Tell us in advance about any days you are unavailable, so we can plan around them.

How to apply

Please send:

• Links to 2–3 long-form YouTube videos you edited, ideally real estate or talking-head content.

• Your rate per finished 15–30 minute video, and any monthly rate for four videos.

• Confirmation that you can meet a 24-hour turnaround, and your working hours in Eastern Time.

• A short note on your experience managing YouTube channels.

• One sentence on how editing for a Canadian audience differs from a US audience.

Shortlisted applicants may be asked to complete one paid test edit.

title: NDIS HR & Compliance Coordinator

This is a hands-on role for someone who is confident managing sensitive employee matters, coordinating performance management processes, and ensuring HR and compliance tasks are completed within required timeframes.

Key Responsibilities

1. HR Support & Employee Relations

-related HR actions where required.

Key Performance Expectations



The successful candidate will:

Maintain accurate records and ensure deadlines are met.

Confidently coordinate employee performance and disciplinary processes.

Monitor workforce compliance requirements relevant to NDIS operations.

Demonstrate sound judgement, discretion, and confidentiality.

About You



We are looking for someone with experience in HR coordination, employee relations, and compliance administration, ideally within the NDIS, disability support, aged care, or another regulated care environment.



You will ideally have:



Experience in HR coordination, HR administration, or employee relations.

Confidence managing performance management and disciplinary processes.

Familiarity with NDIS workforce compliance requirements.

Experience maintaining employee records, compliance registers, and supporting documentation.

Understanding of worker screening, mandatory training, and qualification tracking.

Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

The confidence to handle sensitive employee conversations professionally.

The ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and meet deadlines.

A proactive, solutions-focused approach.

The ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgement.

What We Are Looking For



This is not simply an administrative HR position. We need someone who can confidently manage employee relations matters while ensuring HR and workforce compliance tasks are consistently monitored and completed.



The ideal candidate can identify an issue, determine the next steps, take action, follow up with the relevant people, and keep the General Manager informed without requiring constant reminders.



You should be comfortable balancing HR administration, employee relations, and compliance tracking in a regulated disability support environment.

This is a remote role. The successful candidate must demonstrate accountability, responsiveness, strong communication, and the ability to manage their workload independently.



Performance will be measured by the ability to keep HR matters progressing, meet deadlines, maintain accurate records, monitor workforce compliance requirements, and proactively manage responsibilities.

title: ESTIMATOR – PLANSWIFT MATERIAL TAKE-OFFS
description:
OneWorld Business Solutions is a premier accounting firm based in Perth, WA, specialising in Accounting, Marketing and CFO services. We aim to empower businesses with back-end support to create a sustainable business. 



We are looking for an experienced Estimator to support one of our clients in the construction industry, to complete material take-offs for:



• Wall Partitions

• External Fibre Cement Cladding

• Metal Deck Roofing

• Internal Ceilings



What you’ll do



Review Project Documentation

• Review architectural plans, structural drawings, elevations, sections, details, schedules and specifications.

• Confirm latest drawing revisions are being used.

• Identify system types, construction requirements, materials and finishes.

• Review acoustic, fire-rated, moisture-resistant, weatherproofing and specialty system requirements where specified.

• Coordinate with architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical and hydraulic drawings.



PlanSwift Setup

• Import and calibrate drawings using known dimensions.

• Organise drawings by level, discipline, elevation, building zone, roof area and system type.

• Create assemblies/templates for each wall type, cladding type, roof sheeting profile and ceiling system.

• Establish naming conventions and colour coding for take-offs.



Wall Partitions

• Measure internal partition wall lengths, heights and wall face areas by wall type.

• Quantify metal studs, top and bottom tracks, deflection head tracks, noggings, bridging and backing support.

• Quantify plasterboard, specialty boards, bulkhead framing and lining requirements.

• Quantify acoustic and fire insulation by thickness and density.

• Count door openings and identify door frame support requirements.

• Review service penetrations and allow for framing modifications where required.

• Quantify fixings, jointing materials and sealants.



External Fibre Cement Cladding

• Measure external wall areas by elevation, cladding type and building level where required.

• Measure feature walls, soffits and external ceilings separately.

• Quantify fibre cement sheets and panels by thickness, size, product type and manufacturer specification.

• Apply waste factors based on panel layout and cutting complexity.

• Quantify top hats, battens, support framing, brackets and clips.

• Quantify sarking, membranes, cavity components and fire barriers.

• Measure openings, penetrations, flashings, trims, jointing systems, sealants and coating areas.

• Identify compliant wall build-ups and quantify components required for fire-rated systems.



Metal Deck Roofing

• Measure roof areas by roof type and sheeting profile, accounting for roof pitch.

• Quantify roof sheeting by profile, gauge, coating and finish.

• Allow for side laps, end laps and project-specific waste allowances.

• Identify standard and custom sheet lengths.

• Quantify battens, purlins, bridging, bracing and secondary steel supports.

• Quantify insulation, sarking and vapour barriers.

• Measure flashings, cappings, gutters and downpipes.

• Quantify rainwater heads, sumps, overflow provisions, roof penetrations, roof openings, fixings and accessories.

• Review roof safety requirements.



Internal Ceilings

• Measure ceiling areas by ceiling type and identify differing ceiling heights.

• Quantify ceiling grids, suspension components, tiles, panels and plasterboard linings.

• Measure bulkheads, soffits and feature ceiling elements.

• Quantify framing, additional supports and insulation.

• Count and classify openings, service penetrations and access panels.

• Quantify trims, movement joints, specialty accessories, consumables and fixings.



Coordination and Quality Assurance Review

• Cross-check quantities against plans, elevations, sections and schedules.

• Verify wall, cladding, roof sheeting and ceiling type allocations.

• Review omissions, overlaps, openings, penetrations and interfaces.

• Check framing calculations, flashing lengths, waste allowances and material assumptions.

• Confirm quantities align with project specifications.

• Audit take-offs within PlanSwift before exporting reports.



Deliverables

• PlanSwift marked-up drawings and elevations.

• Wall length, cladding area, roof sheeting quantity and ceiling area reports.

• Framing, support framing, grid system, plasterboard, insulation, sarking and membrane quantities.

• Fibre cement panel and ceiling tile/panel schedules.

• Flashing, capping, trim, jointing and sealant schedules.

• Opening, penetration and access panel schedules.

• Gutter and downpipe quantities.

• Bulkhead and soffit quantities.

• Roof safety system schedule.

• Material summary spreadsheet for pricing.

• Assumptions, exclusions, and qualifications register.



Requirements

• Construction take-off/estimating experience, with commercial projects strongly preferred

• Proficient in PlanSwift for material take-offs, marked-up drawings and quantity reports

• Hands-on take-off experience in at least two of: metal roofing, fibre cement/façade cladding, suspended/plasterboard ceilings, steel stud partitions

• Has background in reading Australian drawings and specs. Familiarity with the NCC and Australian Standards or Australian suppliers is a big plus

• Excellent attention to details and organisational skills. If you have read this far, kindly include the word “apple” in your application

• Strong Excel skills

• Good written and verbal English



What We Offer:

Full-time, fully remote contractor (day shift).

Competitive salary and benefits package.

Opportunities for professional growth and development.

A supportive, fun, and collaborative work environment.



For individual applicants only who can commit full-time.

Not open for agencies and freelancers handling multiple clients at a time.
